news_mentions.headline: Which are the best and worst NFL offseason additions after one week?
news_mentions.body_text: the buildup to week 1 is a marathon nfl teams start reconfiguring their rosters in march signings trades and draft picks cultivate hope and speculation which teams improved which teams did not how will these new players fit into schemes and systems which moves will tell the story of the season all fun questions to consider through the offseason months but the most fascinating part of the process is seeing all the moves come together or fail to mesh when football begins teams provided plenty of early returns on that front as they kicked off the 2026 season last week my goal this season is to monitor all the veteran offseason moves on a week to week basis to determine which signings and trades have been most impactful teams that are crowned offseason champions do not always realize those gains during the actual season some offseason moves that fly under the radar become immensely consequential it is only one week and there is a lot of football to be played still plenty of performances jumped out from week 1 both positively and negatively here are the offseason moves that are trending up and trending down after the first week of action trending up kenneth walker rb kansas city chiefs the chiefs signed walker to a free agent deal averaging 14 35 million per year this offseason andy reid 39 s offenses had lacked an explosive element in the designed running game for years the walker signing seemed to be an attempt to change that the vision came to life in the chiefs 39 31 10 win over the denver broncos on monday night walker rushed for 173 yards on 23 attempts quarterback patrick mahomes played in his first game since suffering a season ending knee injury in december walker is a game changing talent and he will clearly shoulder some of the offensive load as mahomes works his way fully back walker had four explosive rushes in the game including a 60 yard touchdown it was the chiefs 39 longest rush since 2019 last year isiah pacheco had four explosive rushes all season kareem hunt had five the chiefs offense changed decisively with walker in the backfield mahomes averaged 0 05 epa per dropback in monday 39 s win according to trumedia previously the chiefs had only won 10 games in mahomes 39 career when the quarterback averaged 0 05 epa per dropback or worse isaiah likely te new york giants the giants signed likely to a three year 40 million contract in free agency he had a standout debut for new york catching eight passes for 78 yards and two touchdowns likely was fourth among all players in epa per route run in week 1 according to trumedia he is already emerging as a security blanket for second year quarterback jaxson dart who looked comfortable and surgical in the new giants offense likely missed time last season with a fractured foot he suffered in training camp he finished 2025 with career lows in receptions yards and touchdowns the giants and new head coach john harbaugh still paid likely as a top five tight end harbaugh and likely were together with the baltimore ravens from 2022 to 39 25 likely is making good on that deal through one week tyler linderbaum c las vegas raiders the raiders signed linderbaum to a giant contract averaging 27 million in annual value this offseason he was excellent in week 1 against the miami dolphins as new coach klint kubiak got his tenure started with a win linderbaum did not allow a pressure he was a complete difference maker in the run and pass games the raiders had a positive epa per designed rush according to trumedia they did not have such a game in 2025 the raiders allowed a pressure rate of 22 6 percent on quarterback kirk cousins that was better than all but one game in 2025 linderbaum looks like he will be a force multiplier for the raiders 39 offensive line we will see how the raiders perform against more talented fronts starting in week 2 against the los angeles chargers all three of the cincinnati bengals 39 big defensive additions the bengals overhauled their defense this offseason with three splash moves they traded for defensive tackle dexter lawrence they signed edge rusher boye mafe and safety bryan cook in free agency in a week 1 win over the tampa bay buccaneers the bengals looked like a dramatically elevated unit those three additions all played huge roles cook had a forced fumble that was recovered by mafe cook recovered a baker mayfield fumble in the end zone and lawrence created the initial pressure that forced mayfield from the pocket on a fumble return touchdown in the first quarter mafe created the initial pressure on mayfield mafe also had a sack fumble on mayfield beating all pro tackle tristan wirfs the bengals will be competitive this season if they can maintain this level of disruption on defense they have the horses now on that side of the ball dylan parham g new york jets the jets won their opener over the tennessee titans and new offensive coordinator frank reich was clearly determined to establish the rushing attack in his first game calling plays the jets called designed runs on 65 6 percent of their early downs in the first 28 minutes of sunday 39 s game according to trumedia jets backs breece hall and braelon allen combined for 142 rushing yards on 32 carries parham who signed a two year 16 million deal with the jets this offseason played a big part in that performance as the starting left guard reich was taking advantage of parham 39 s athleticism by using him as a puller parham was very good as a run blocker he also held his own in pass protection against jeffery simmons one of the best interior rushers in football the jets have a solid group up front on offense and they seem determined to lean on that strength in the running game kwity paye edge las vegas raiders the raiders gave paye 16 million per year in free agency he had eight pressures in the raiders 39 week 1 win over the dolphins interestingly the raiders and defensive coordinator rob leonard rushed paye from the interior in sunday 39 s game when they got to three edge rusher packages maxx crosby and malcolm koonce were on the edges on those looks paye 39 s pocket pushing and motor really played up in these situations a notable wrinkle that could elevate paye 39 s production it was not something he did often in indianapolis trey hendrickson edge baltimore ravens hendrickson was the top player in my free agency rankings in march the ravens signed him to a four year 112 million deal after the crosby trade with the raiders fell through hendrickson had an encouraging showing in his ravens debut as baltimore dismantled the indianapolis colts hendrickson missed time last season with a core injury on sunday he looked healthy powerful and explosive he finished with four pressures and got the better of colts left tackle bernhard raimann roy lopez idl arizona cardinals lopez was not a splash signing this offseason he joined the cardinals on a two year 10 5 million deal lopez was extremely disruptive in the cardinals 39 surprise win over the chargers the chargers 39 interior offensive line struggled to block lopez both in the run and pass games he was one of the cardinals 39 best players in an impressive defensive performance trending down devin lloyd lb carolina panthers the panthers were active on defense in free agency they signed edge rusher jaelan phillips to a deal averaging 30 million per year they signed lloyd to a deal averaging 15 million per year then they went out in week 1 and gave up 59 points to the chicago bears the bears rushed for 291 yards phillips was decent lloyd struggled in all phases he missed tackles he got moved in the run game and was late to diagnose rushing tracks he struggled in coverage including on some zone looks lloyd had flashes as a blitzer but those moments were negated by caleb williams 39 pocket management and escapability lloyd did not look like the same player he was during a breakout season in 2025 it was a rough debut odafe oweh edge washington commanders the commanders signed oweh to a four year 96 million contract in free agency it was a lot of money for a player who filled a third edge role for the chargers after landing in los angeles via trade in october the commanders need oweh to play like a no 1 edge he did not perform at that level in a week 1 loss to the philadelphia eagles oweh had one clean up sack and a tackle for loss in the run game but he was not impactful on a down to down basis he had trouble getting loose from eagles tackles jordan mailata and lane johnson among 96 players with at least 20 pass rush snaps in week 1 oweh ranked 84th in pressure rate according to trumedia romeo doubs wr new england patriots this offseason the patriots cut stefon diggs and signed doubs to a four year 80 million contract doubs had a horrible debut in the league 39 s season opener last week against the seattle seahawks a j brown who the patriots traded for in june suffered an injury in the second half doubs did not step up as needed after brown went down doubs did not have a catch on three targets he had a game swinging drop on what would have been an explosive play in the fourth quarter of a tie game brown is on injured reserve now and will miss at least the next four games the patriots need far more out of doubs they used him more as a vertical down the field player doubs really thrives more on possession routes new england offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels will need to find a way to get doubs more involved and doubs must make the plays that come his way myles garrett edge los angeles rams the rams trading for garrett was the biggest splash of the offseason garrett however looked shockingly human in the rams 39 loss to the san francisco 49ers in australia garrett was subsequently placed on ir with a knee injury that injury explains a lot because garrett was clearly not himself against the 49ers left tackle trent williams and right tackle colton mckivitz were both very solid in one on one reps against garrett 34 this was the worst version of myself that i 39 ve put out there 34 garrett said after the game according to our nate atkins he will miss at least the next four games a disastrous start to garrett 39 s los angeles chapter john franklin myers idl tennessee titans robert saleh took over as titans coach this offseason tennessee spent in free agency to give saleh talent on defense including signing corners alontae taylor and cor 39 dale flott and franklin myers on the interior the jets ran the ball very well and that limited pass rushing opportunities franklin myers was not a big factor in the game against the run or pass he had just one pressure the titans signed franklin myers to a deal averaging 21 million per year franklin myers is a very talented rusher the titans have to stop the run better to get the most out of their expensive front seven signing this article originally news_mentions.headline: Ryan Fitzpatrick: 0-17 season 'within reach' for 2026 Dolphins
news_mentions.description: Before the season began, former Miami quarterback Ryan Fitzpatrick predicted the Dolphins could go 0-17 in 2026. After one week, he’s not scrambling away from that suggestion.
news_mentions.body_text: before the season began former miami dolphins quarterback ryan fitzpatrick predicted the fins could go 0 17 in 2026 after one week he s not scrambling away from that suggestion on a promotional tour for amazon prime s first thursday night football game this week the qb turned analyst doubled down in comments to barry jackson of the miami herald fitzpatrick s logic stems from miami s overhauled roster thanks to deals given out by the previous front office part of it is self inflicted with all the dead money fitzpatrick told jackson they ve got over 180 million in dead cap tua tagovailoa tyreek hill jaylen waddle bradley chubb jalen ramsey minkah fitzpatrick all those guys that are on the books but not on the roster that s part of it the dolphins lost 27 13 to the las vegas raiders in week 1 fitzpatrick noted that first year coach jeff hafley s august comments about the 2026 season not being measured by wins and losses in miami were telling jeff hafley s comments and reading between the tea leaves with him saying success isn t measured by wins and losses that said a lot he said the amount of guys they claimed off waivers seven after that first cut there s a lot going on that reminded me of that 2019 season there the 2019 dolphins were in a supposed tanking situation under first year coach brian flores however fitzpatrick and co managed to earn five victories the former journeyman quarterback added that not only does the roster situation remind him of 2019 but the schedule also lends itself to a potentially difficult season in miami we started 0 7 in 2019 we lost the first four games by an average of 34 points a game a game we were not even given the chance to succeed fitzpatrick said so 0 17 i feel is within reach and part of it is because of who they re playing they re playing the nfc north and afc west which i think is really important their other games are at san fran indy and cincy the jets look like they re going to be better i just started doing the calculations and thought gosh this is a real possibility but the people that can get in the way of a tank are the coaches and the players and that s what happened in 2019 so i m rooting for them to screw it up and get in the way of it but i think 0 17 is realistic in the super bowl era three teams have gone winless excluding shortened seasons the 1976 tampa bay buccaneers finished 0 14 as an expansion team the 2008 detroit lions and 2017 cleveland browns each went 0 16 the nfl moved to 17 games in 2021 miami goes on the road to face the san francisco 49ers 1 0 at 4 25 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Brian Flores-Ben Johnson showdown takes center stage in Vikings-Bears Week 2 matchup
news_mentions.body_text: two years ago in the lead up to one of these clashes a reporter coaxed a smile out of then detroit lions offensive coordinator ben johnson the reporter had asked about minnesota vikings defensive coordinator brian flores 39 blitz packages how the reporter wondered did the relentless pressure tax players 39 minds johnson steely as ever listened to the full question a grin formed 34 yeah um 133 34 johnson said before chuckling his initial reaction carried a tinge of mischief it felt like the reaction of a poker shark at a hold 39 em table the type of response you 39 d have about an opponent you know is always up to something the reporter followed up on the initial question citing a compliment from flores about johnson 39 s abilities how flattering was that to hear 34 i think he 39 s trying to just butter us up a little bit 34 johnson said he smirked once more another brief window into a vaunted back and forth that returns this weekend johnson is now the head coach of the chicago bears and for the seventh time these two foes will meet in a critical nfc north matchup winning offers far more than just bragging rights the victor will establish solid footing in a divisional race that 39 s likely to be decided down the stretch it simplifies the nuances of any matchup to pit two play callers against each other this though is a special case johnson 39 s offense represents creativity and detail born from a self made coaching career flores 39 defense embodies a trademark fearlessness the vikings don 39 t blitz because it 39 s flashy or because it produces eye popping graphics they send waves of bodies at offenses from all sides because that 39 s what they think is most likely to produce the right result johnson has publicly stated his preference for points and blowouts flores makes no bones about his desire to apply a vise grip to opposing offenses neither settles for satisfaction both recognize the challenge the other presents 34 they do a great job 34 flores said tuesday afternoon 34 there 39 s shifts there 39 s motions there 39 s a lot of eye candy they do everything that could potentially give a defense problems 34 he even offered a window into how his mind might work sunday at soldier field employ one deep safety and chicago 39 s wideouts may feast against man to man coverage shift and feature two deep safeties and the bears could find susceptibilities in minnesota 39 s ability to stop the run and that 39 s only the tip of the iceberg safety positioning matters but so do protection rules and pre snap signals and down and distance tendencies each coverage choice comes with a cost different run concepts open the door to holes all avenues of communication matter because they could contain the key for either side to decipher the deception as former vikings defensive lineman harrison phillips put it several years ago playing johnson is like navigating a volatile stock market you enter with expectations but every drive seems like a forecasting exercise does it make sense to sell off while ahead should minnesota adjust schematically even if the team is succeeding or does it make sense to stick with the investment should minnesota maintain its approach betting against chicago 39 s ability to find a quick answer the shared history only adds to the complexity of the decisions 34 each week you try to find a weakness in the armor and look to attack it 34 johnson said ahead of the highly anticipated vikings lions bout in week 18 of the 2024 season 34 this defense doesn 39 t have much and it 39 s been that way for two years now you can tell that this whole unit has been together they have the answers they know how to respond when they get hit with something 34 going back to johnson and flores 39 first faceoffs in 2023 a visual breakdown of the quarter by quarter efficiency statistics looks like a round by round scoring of hagler hearns throwing the uppercut is less important than being able to absorb one in the week 7 confrontation between johnson 39 s lions and flores 39 vikings in 2024 minnesota limited detroit to a minuscule 21 4 percent success rate in the first quarter detroit answered with a ridiculous 61 1 percent success rate in the second quarter the lions kept their momentum with a 54 5 percent success rate in the third quarter but the vikings eliminated the rhythm by holding them to a 27 8 percent success rate in the fourth detroit won 31 29 but the lopsided blow by blow revealed the ingenuity of their staffs and players both coaches worked with a collective to identify and solve problems on the fly this takes sharp eyes from above intricate sideline dialogue and shrewd on field adaptation 34 any type of offense that 39 s out there ground and pound run and shoot rpo 4 by 1 he 39 s got it 34 flores said 34 so what are we getting this week it 39 s hard to know a lot of the game is adjustments if they do this we want to do this we 39 re going to have our own game plan and it 39 s the same on his end with him asking 39 what are they doing how are we going to counteract it 39 34 last year against flores johnson utilized condensed formations quick snaps and third down runs at a notable clip flores meanwhile kept his max pressure calls to a minimum against johnson he also deployed mostly zone coverage out of heavier personnel to neutralize the bears 39 run pass multiplicity also like poker players they understand the others 39 preferences they know what moves the other prefers to make on the field 34 it 39 s one of the things i love about coaching defense in this division in the nfc 34 flores said 34 it 39 s a lot of fun 34 it 39 s fun to watch as well this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Falcons HC Kevin Stefanski 'not ruling anybody out' at QB for Week 2 vs. Panthers
news_mentions.description: Atlanta's quarterback situation remains murky at best. Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski is leaving open every possibility at the position for Week 2's home-opener agianst the Carolina Panthers
news_mentions.body_text: atlanta s quarterback situation remains murky at best falcons head coach kevin stefanski is leaving open every possibility at the position for week 2 s home opener against the carolina panthers telling reporters wednesday his staff is not ruling anybody out we will have a quarterback yes for this week stefanski said that includes michael penix tua tagovailoa cooper rush and undrafted rookie jack strand theoretically all could play and it seems mid week stefanski isn t interested in revealing any additional information i m not trying to be coy stefanski said when pressed on whether penix who was inactive for week 1 might become available i m just not ruling anybody out continue to work through it we re all on the same page between myself the medical team mike we ll work through all those things for wednesday s record tagovailoa didn t practice due to an oblique injury he suffered in practice last week penix knee and rush back practiced fully while strand isn t being ruled out as a potential participant on sunday in atlanta per stefanski penix told reporters wednesday that he split first team reps with rush at practice and he wouldn t rule out playing sunday i m working extremely hard penix said adding that he s close to a return from his latest acl injury i m dying to be out there this type of multifaceted update was never part of stefanski s plan entering 2026 the falcons understood they were approaching the new season with expected uncertainty due to penix s recovery from his knee injury and that s why they signed tagovailoa as veteran insurance they didn t foresee tagovailoa beginning camp with an injury prompting atlanta to sign rush out of necessity and suffering another injury just days before the regular season penix s return could solve their problems atlanta isn t going to rush it in september though otherwise stefanski might have to play this game of cat and mouse all season long i think you guys talked to mike and mike will explain what we re doing with the progression as he comes back stefanski explained like i told you guys i feel really good about the plan and where we are i m not gonna get into specific conversations with our players but mike is progressing and doing a good job but we ll see how it goes for now he ll repeat the same lines and remain vague it wouldn t benefit him much to name a starter entering week 2 anyway especially after how uninspiring their offense was in week 1 with rush under center in a 20 13 loss to the pittsburgh steelers eventually though the falcons would like this chatter to subside and certainty to appear under center

news_mentions.headline: Colts WR Keenan Allen formally charged in alleged drunken driving incident
news_mentions.description: Colts receiver Keenan Allen will face two misdemeanor charges in an alleged drunken driving incident, according to court records.
news_mentions.body_text: indianapolis indianapolis colts receiver keenan allen will face two misdemeanor charges in an alleged drunken driving incident according to court records the six time pro bowler was formally charged tuesday with operating a vehicle with alcohol concentration equivalent to 0 15 or more and operating a vehicle while intoxicated he posted 500 cash bond and his attorneys waived an initial hearing that had been scheduled for wednesday an attorney conference is set for oct 26 colts coach shane steichen declined to address the latest twist before wednesday s practice at which allen is expected to be a participant allen has not addressed the incident publicly according to the indianapolis metropolitan police department officers conducted a traffic investigation on aug 30 shortly after 1 a m after observing a vehicle park in a no parking zone officers noticed signs of intoxication when they spoke with allen he was arrested after further investigation the 34 year old allen is in his 14th nfl season his first with indy after spending 12 of his previous 13 years with the san diego los angeles chargers he signed with the colts on aug 19 reuniting him with steichen who was a chargers assistant for the first seven years of allen s career allen had 81 receptions for 777 yards and four touchdowns in 17 games with the chargers last season when he broke the franchise s career receptions record he finished his chargers career with 985 catches 11 307 yards and 63 tds in sunday s season opening 41 23 loss to the baltimore ravens allen led the colts with six receptions but had only 32 yards allen needs two receptions to pass andre johnson 1 062 for 12th and 64 yards to pass charlie joiner for 30th on the nfl s career lists his 70 td catches are tied for 52nd all time copyright 2026 by the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker, Bears RB D'Andre Swift highlight Players of the Week
news_mentions.description: Chicago running back D'Andre Swift and Kansas City running back Kenneth Walker earned Offensive Player of the Week accolades for the first week of the season.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in week 1 each wednesday the league unveils its weekly honor roll see who the players of the week are below afc offensive player of the week in his first game with the chiefs and since winning super bowl mvp for the seahawks walker stole the show as he propelled kansas city to an impressive 31 0 victory over the broncos walker posted a career best 173 rushing yards on 23 carries with a 60 yard highlight reel touchdown run included and added a td reception his 191 scrimmage yards were also a career high and the most for a reigning super bowl mvp in week 1 breaking hall of famer jerry rice s 1989 record of 180 this is walker s first player of the week accolade since earning nfc offensive honors in week 3 2023 nfc offensive player of the week swift was a driving force in chicago s scoring parade sunday as the bears blasted the panthers 59 37 swift ran wild to the tune of 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries swift had a pair of 1 yard scores before putting the finishing touches on the scorefest with a 28 yard run to the house this is swift s second career player of the week accolade and his first with the bears afc defensive player of the week for the ninth time in his stellar career but the first time since week 8 2024 watt has earned dpow the recognition comes after he stuffed the box score in a 20 13 win sunday over the falcons highlighted by a 35 yard interception return for a touchdown the first of his career watt s outing saw him generate four tackles three for loss two qb hits and two sacks nfc defensive player of the week in the eagles narrow 24 22 win over the commanders baun was a tackling machine posting 12 tackles in total he also had two pass breakups and one tackle for loss as he garnered his second career defensive player of the week accolade afc special teams player of the week in cincinnati s 33 27 win over tampa bay on sunday mcpherson simply piled on the points the kicker racked up 15 in total as he was perfect on three extra points and four field goals 20 55 58 32 after the bengals jumped out to a 21 7 lead mcpherson s four field goals closed out his squad s scoring mcpherson s now been named afc special teams player of the week five times nfc special teams player of the week fehoko played a pivotal role in the cardinals 26 14 win over the chargers on sunday with the cards lead cut to 16 14 fehoko came up huge with a blocked punt two plays later arizona increased its lead with a trey mcbride touchdown in his sixth nfl season with his third club fehoko is taking home his first player of the week honor

news_mentions.headline: Mike McGlinchey on loss to Chiefs: Broncos must 'flush it as fast as possible'
news_mentions.description: The defending AFC West champion Denver Broncos got walloped by the Kansas City Chiefs, 31-10, on Monday night.
news_mentions.body_text: the kansas city chiefs embarrassed the defending afc west champion denver broncos in week 1 s 31 10 shellacking at arrowhead stadium denver got bullied in every phase of the game the offense was in sync for one series the entire game bo nix was rattled never looking comfortable and made some ghastly mistakes the offensive line a strength got beat particularly by k c s young players the defense was woeful missed 28 tackles and was bulldozed by kenneth walker all denver can do is move on you ve got to take it for what it is right tackle mike mcglinchey said tuesday via the team s official website you ve got to take it you ve got to learn from it you ve got to flush it as fast as possible after our meetings today and move on to the next opponent the broncos were held to just 176 total yards of offense in davis webb s debut as denver s play caller in week 1 the fewest yards for the broncos in sean payton s tenure as head coach per next gen stats the last time denver had fewer yards was week 16 2021 when the drew lock led broncos only had 158 yards against the raiders if the offense continues to look disjointed it won t be long before payton takes back play calling from webb one game doesn t define our season or who we are mcglinchey said we ve just got to learn how to get better from it the defense fared no better than the offense with the 28 missed tackles accounting for 247 yards for k c the most yards allowed by any defense on missed tackles in a game since at least 2018 per ngs eight different defenders missed multiple tackles on the night the task gets no easier for denver with afc south champs jacksonville jaguars who looked good week 1 the los angeles rams san francisco 49ers los angeles chargers and seattle seahawks on tap over the next five weeks when you can remove the emotion and the things and the expectations of what we wanted to do versus what we did you can see it from a clear lens of why the mistakes were made what situations did we put ourselves in and how do we not put ourselves in that position moving forward mcglinchey said and i think every opportunity is a way to learn win lose or draw if you re not learning you re not growing and you re not going to be successful flush the feelings that you have today flush the embarrassment flush all that stuff and then just get onto the task at hand and take it at face value which is we have a job to do and we have to figure out how to do that job well if denver doesn t flush the loss quickly their season could be the next thing circling the toilet

news_mentions.headline: Drake Maye channels Bill Belichick after loss to Seahawks: 'We're on to Pittsburgh'
news_mentions.description: Drake Maye threw three fourth-quarter interceptions in New England's Week 1 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: new england patriots quarterback drake maye took a page from bill belichick s book when asked monday about the dastardly end to the season opening loss in seattle we re on to pittsburgh maye said on weei via boston com we ve got another week another chance in this league and that s dealing with the ups and downs in this league that s part of it playing the national football league belichick who left the patriots the year before maye was drafted famously repeated the phrase we re on to cincinnati back in 2014 after an awful early season 41 14 loss to the kansas city chiefs the phrase became a rallying cry as the pats won their next eight games en route to a super bowl championship maye struggled mightily down the stretch of last wednesday s season opener tossing three woeful fourth quarter interceptions including the loss sealing int the third year qb completed 23 of 33 pass attempts for 178 yards one touchdown and a career high three interceptions in week 1 maye was efficient on throws under 10 air yards completing 20 of his 23 such attempts for 134 yards and a td 8 9 cpoe but struggled downfield 10 air yards connecting on just three of eight attempts for 44 yards and three ints 12 7 cpoe per next gen stats despite the dismal outing maye believes the pats offense can turn it around swiftly i think there were plays out there to be made maye said i think we had plays in the run game plays in the passing game where we had opportunities to make big plays and in this league we feel last week the way we approached it was a good plan we were ahead on the score and then in the fourth quarter still had a chance to win the game and send it to overtime at the worst i ve got to be better and i will be better going forward maye aims to improve in week 2 against a steelers defense that feasted on backup falcons qb cooper rush last sunday t j watt was a menace recording his 10th career interception on a fourth quarter pick six the pats offensive line did a better job in week 1 than in the super bowl but if the club is to get off the mat following last week s loss they ll have to protect maye from the steelers formidable pass rush

news_mentions.headline: Eagles guard Landon Dickerson: I was 'complete liability' in Week 1 win over Commanders
news_mentions.description: Eagles guard Landon Dickerson, reportedly headed to injured reserve, said on Monday that he was "a complete liability" in the team's Week 1 win.
news_mentions.body_text: the philadelphia eagles offensive line played poorly in week 1 s win over the washington commanders three time pro bowl left guard landon dickerson who has been placed on injured reserve took ownership for his part of the struggles during an appearance on wip s players lounge show on monday i was a complete liability yesterday again that was my fault dickerson said i know i said earlier in camp i shouldn t be out there until i feel healthy a few weeks ago got rolled up on in practice i thought as weeks went by it would get better it didn t and we kind of went out there and finally got some imaging on it today figured out what was wrong with it dickerson has dealt with injuries the past several seasons including a meniscus repair in august 2025 he played 15 games last season but was clearly not himself the guard has admitted he shouldn t have returned as early as he did now he s hoping to avoid a similar issue the philadelphia inquirer and espn reported that dickerson is expected to land on ir the 27 year old described the injury as a bone bruise in his right knee dickerson didn t officially confirm the move to ir but he noted he d assume the reporting is correct really the best plan going forward is to put me on ir so i can get this thing better to have a good stretch at the back end of the season versus kind of what happened last year go out there limping through 18 weeks he said i don t think anybody wants to see that again because that was just ugly i don t want to do that again because that was just some bs drew kendall a 2025 fifth round pick could fill in for dickerson after a solid training camp willie lampkin is another interior option

news_mentions.headline: Kenneth Walker III pummels Broncos in debut with Chiefs
news_mentions.description: Newly added running back Kenneth Walker III rushed for 173 yards, including a 60-yard TD dash, in his first game in Kansas City.
news_mentions.body_text: kenneth walker s first game in kansas city went as advertised the running back signed in the offseason to revamp a sluggish ground game galloped through the denver broncos defense to the tune of 173 rushing yards including a 60 yard td blast and added 18 yards on three catches with another score in monday night s 31 10 chiefs win walker s physicality ability to break tackles and home run capacity were game changers for an offense that previously leaned too heavily on patrick mahomes making magic i told you all literally like first press conference y all were asking what s the difference with our offense and i said k9 like it s just that simple mahomes said after the win via the team s official transcript it s the way he s able to run the ball catch the ball i threw a little hot to him there on that read that was probably going to be a big play but it s just a special ability to run the ball tough between the tackles and then when he does bounce it he has the speed to go all the way and so we ll utilize him walker set career highs with his 173 rushing yards and 191 scrimmage yards after sharing the backfield with zach charbonnet in seattle walker fit seamlessly in k c as the top dog you know you ve got to be making yards and for him to play the way that he did i thought it was spectacular said coach andy reid it was something you hope for and you got to see it where he was the main guy there and he did a great job with it i ll also say that our rb emmett johnson did a nice job too when he had an opportunity to get in there both those guys are contact balances ridiculous and so they got a lot of yards after contact and that s a special thing to have there walker picked up where he left off last season winning the super bowl mvp with the seattle seahawks his 191 scrimmage yards were the most by a reigning super bowl mvp in week 1 surpassing the previous record of 180 set by hall of famer jerry rice in 1989 per nfl research his career high 173 rushing yards in week 1 are the second highest by any veteran in their debut with a new team behind michael turner s 220 yard performance in his 2008 debut with the falcons perhaps most notable walker s 173 rushing yards were also the most by any player in a game started by mahomes the chiefs have employed an afterthought rushing attack for most of mahomes reign they have never had a 1 000 yard rusher since the qb took over as the starter and the last several seasons have been highly inefficient walker s arrival changed that instantly walker s ability to create splash plays completely changes the k c offense he generated 101 rushing yards over expected per nfl pro and forced a whopping 14 missed tackles the rb showed all of his attributes including game breaking speed on a 60 yard touchdown we ran the play a few times walker said of his 60 yard score i knew they were going to crash in so when they crashed in i just bounced it out i was one on one with the corner i outran him and it was off to the races from there the 60 yard scamper was the chiefs longest run since 2019 when damien williams had td runs of 91 and 84 yards over the past two seasons the longest run by any k c player was 35 yards wr xavier worthy the chiefs force fed walker the ball 26 times including 23 carries reinforcing their belief that he s a three down player it means a lot walker said of the workload it means they trust me it s good to feel that way starting undrafted rookie kahlil benson at left tackle the chiefs knew pounding the rock would be the most prudent way to protect the young blocker that it fit perfectly with the revamped plan this offseason was a bonus the offensive line took it as a challenge to go up against this defense and set the tone and they did that mahomes said and so even though the pass game didn t click the way we wanted it to click early especially it set the tone for the entire game of how we were going to move the ball down the field

news_mentions.headline: NFL ties Week 1 scoring record for Super Bowl era
news_mentions.description: Thanks to the Kansas City Chiefs and Denver Broncos reaching 41 combined points on Monday night, the opening slate of games for the 2026 season tied a record for the most Week 1 points scored during the Super Bowl era.
news_mentions.body_text: a 14 year week 1 record has been matched thanks to the kansas city chiefs and denver broncos combining for 41 points on monday night the opening slate of games for the 2026 season has officially tied the 2012 season s record for the most week 1 points scored 791 during the super bowl era entering monday s afc west showdown teams had averaged 50 0 combined points per game per nfl research with the week 1 finale bringing the average down to 49 4 tying such a mark would ve been hard to see coming on wednesday when the seattle seahawks and new england patriots kicked off the campaign with a 13 10 defensive battle in a super bowl lx rematch much of the rest of the weekend however took a different path offensive explosions proved the norm caleb williams and the chicago bears dropped 59 points on the carolina panthers the franchise s most since the 1980 season and it s not as if carolina s offense was hapless attempting to keep up the panthers put 37 on the board contributing to the highest scoring week 1 game 96 combined points in league history lamar jackson s baltimore ravens scored 41 against the indianapolis colts while josh allen s buffalo bills required a similar output to defeat the houston texans 36 31 a somewhat shocking result considering demeco ryans club hasn t allowed that many points since his first year leading houston in 2023 the jacksonville jaguars opened a large enough lead that trevor lawrence sat out the fourth quarter of a 34 10 win over the cleveland browns and the minnesota vikings who defeated the green bay packers 39 22 at one point scored 22 points in 2 46 of game time during the fourth quarter the nfl s scoring frenzy stands in stark contrast to the commonly held belief that defenses typically begin the season ahead of offenses it was not so this week leading to record tying results

news_mentions.headline: Broncos-Chiefs on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Kansas City's 31-10 win
news_mentions.description: After failing to win the AFC West last season for the first time in a decade, the Kansas City Chiefs kicked off the new campaign by dominating the Denver Broncos, who dethroned them in 2025.
news_mentions.body_text: kenneth dials up the kc frequency roughly eight months after taking home super bowl lx mvp honors with the seahawks kenneth walker hit the kansas city ground running and didn t look back walker was sensational from start to finish commanding the spotlight in a performance that lends credence to this being very much a new look and new approach chiefs offense walker s first game in a chiefs uniform ended with him rushing for a career high 173 yards including a 60 yard touchdown run to go with a 2 yard touchdown catch on a forward toss from the triumphantly returning patrick mahomes how walker began the game was probably just as telling he carried it on the chiefs first four plays and seven total on an opening td march that ended with mahomes scrambling in for a 15 yard score the chiefs haven t had a 1 000 yard rusher since kareem hunt in 2017 the last season mahomes wasn t a starter while walker won the super bowl s top individual honor he did so because his former seahawks teammate zach charbonnet was injured for the majority of 2025 walker split carries though the chiefs surprisingly ran roughshod over the broncos defense with rookie emmett johnson and mahomes also chipping in here and there this was walker s night and a message on the marquee the chiefs are going to run the ball and walker will be a workhorse davis denver offense stymied as patrick mahomes made his much ballyhooed return after tearing his acl and lcl last season his former texas tech teammate davis webb was making his debut as the broncos play caller and offensive coordinator monday went much better for mahomes webb and broncos qb bo nix in his first game since breaking his ankle in the divisional round never found any consistent success kenneth walker s 191 total yards for the chiefs bested the broncos 176 nix looked sharper earlier passing than mahomes but it made no matter as the game wore on with denver shockingly held to nine first downs and its ground game non existent j k dobbins was the leading ground gainer with a meager 36 yards while nix s 19 yard td toss to evan engram to tie the game in the first quarter was really the last splash of any kind had by webb s offense after the chiefs vaulted ahead 21 7 on a stellar 60 yard gallop by walker in the third quarter mahomes was picked off by brandon jones on the chiefs ensuing drive set up at the kc 5 yard line nix and the offense went backward and settled for a 31 yard field goal by wil lutz denver s last points of the game with such high expectations and such a disastrous debut for webb and the offense one has to wonder how long head coach sean payton will wait until snatching the offensive reins back mahomes returns chiefs win somehow some way patrick mahomes return nine months to the day of ripping multiple ligaments was overshadowed by the debut of a soft spoken loud running kenneth walker nonetheless mahomes had his moments in a return to action that had more good than bad but was hardly vintage pat the first six points of the game were had by mahomes when he scrambled up the gut and dove head first for a 15 yard touchdown carrying his hulking left knee brace along with him if any of the score s symbolism was lost mahomes made sure to underscore it by flexing his right arm to the camera he was back strong as ever the three time super bowl mvp showed some unease in the pocket though often more comfortable perhaps surprisingly on the move and was at times woefully inaccurate he finished 15 of 27 for 184 yards two touchdowns and an interception he hit rashee rice on a screen that the receiver took in for a 13 yard score and his td pass to walker was an underhand toss there is plenty more for mahomes to show to prove the mahomes of old is back with walker in place though andy reid has made it known that the chiefs are changing gears this no longer has to be mahomes carrying the entire offense on his shoulders and surgically repaired knee he can progress week by week and the chiefs can still be viable they were dominant on monday thanks to walker and a stellar defensive performance most importantly mahomes is back and the chiefs returned to the winner s circle in his return stopping a three game skid against the broncos and an overall six game losing streak dating back to last season broncos d is no show for as problematic as the broncos offensive showing was their defensive performance was perhaps more worrisome bo nix and the offense beyond perhaps one of the better offensive lines in the game is truly still a work in progress vance joseph s defense is coming off back to back seasons as the no 3 unit in points allowed yet the chiefs dominated them in humbling fashion by running them over most troubling was that this vaunted group that s eyeing setting all time sack records was absolutely horrendous in its tackling or lack thereof eight broncos missed multiple tackles per next gen stats as a whole denver missed 28 tackles giving up 247 yards on those missed tackles which is the most by any defense since at least 2018 per ngs many were of the mind that if nix wasn t injured in the playoffs denver might well have advanced to the super bowl last season thusly many believed the broncos could be super bowl bound this year well denver got nix back but this certainly looked nothing like the defense of the last two seasons chiefs rookies show promise as uneven as patrick mahomes was passing the ball when he connected with travis kelce for a 59 yarder in the third quarter it was a snapshot of the glory days of the chiefs dynasty that really wasn t that long ago kansas city s win had plenty to do with new faces though most obvious was kenneth walker but undrafted free agent kahlil benson starting at left tackle where he didn t play in college and presented the team s biggest question mark was stellar in 32 pass block snaps he allowed just one qb pressure rookie second rounder r mason thomas had a pair of qb pressures and one of the chiefs four sacks first round pick mansoor delane had an interception before exiting with a shoulder injury which was easily the largest negative for the chiefs on the evening shifty rookie running back emmett johnson put together 68 scrimmage yards and the refurbishing of the chiefs after a 6 11 season is off and running with faces old and new making valuable contributions against an afc heavyweight next gen stats insight for broncos chiefs via nfl pro bo nix was pressured on 45 5 of his dropacks the second highest pressure rate faced in his career nfl research kenneth walker had a career high 191 scrimmage yards in his chiefs debut the most scrimmage yards by a reigning super bowl mvp in week 1 surpassing the previous record of 180 set by hall of famer jerry rice in 1989 walker s career best 173 rushing yards in week 1 are second by a veteran player in their debut with a new team behind michael turner s 220 yard performance in his 2008 debut with the falcons

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs' Travis Kelce moves into second place for all-time tight end receiving yards
news_mentions.description: Travis Kelce moved into second place all-time for receiving yards by a tight end during the Chiefs’ season opener Monday night against the Broncos.
news_mentions.body_text: it was quite a milestone offseason for travis kelce the kansas city chiefs tight end wasted no time in making it a milestone regular season as well kelce moved into second all time for receiving yards by a tight end during the chiefs 31 10 season opening monday night win over the denver broncos predictably kelce downplayed the individual milestone when speaking to espn s laura rutledge after the game it s a good feeling to get this win all the other stuff is just hoopla now he said kelce caught a 59 yard pass from old friend patrick mahomes in the third quarter to put him past longtime dallas cowboys stalwart jason witten for second all time ahead of monday s season opener kelce had 13 002 yards needing 45 to surpass witten 13 046 the catch was a turn back the clock moment for kelce standing as his longest reception since week 15 2021 when he turned in a 69 yarder versus the los angeles chargers it was a memorable way to begin kelce s 14th and perhaps final season the three time super bowl winner now trails only hall of famer tony gonzalez 15 127 in receiving yards by a tight end though the 36 year old s career is winding down his star status is not thanks in large part to his recent nuptials to pop megastar taylor swift a no doubt future hall of famer kelce an 11 time pro bowler and four time all pro ranks fifth among tight ends with 82 touchdowns and third in receptions 1 083 among his other notable accomplishments kelce has the most 100 yard games by a tight end 38 and his 1 416 yards in 2020 remaining a single season best at the position kelce s earned another tip of the helmet for what s been an astounding career but this season is just beginning as he aims to help his chiefs return to prior heavyweight status

news_mentions.headline: Seahawks: Sam Darnold has 'very unique' soft-tissue injury, no firm timeline for return
news_mentions.description: Seattle Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold is dealing with a "very unique soft-tissue injury" to his glute and his hip joint is unaffected, the team announced Monday.
news_mentions.body_text: seattle seahawks quarterback sam darnold is dealing with a very unique soft tissue injury to his glute and his hip joint is unaffected the team announced monday darnold s injury is not considered to be a long term injury but there is no firm timeline on his return to the field darnold who led the seahawks to a super bowl title in his first season with the team exited wednesday s kickoff game win over the patriots with what was initially labeled a hip injury the seahawks returned to practice on monday and darnold was not seen on the field during the portion available to the media per espn seahawks head coach mike macdonald is next scheduled to speak to reporters on wednesday monday s update comes after nfl network insider ian rapoport reported thursday that darnold avoided a major injury and could miss a few weeks macdonald said during a radio interview that same day that the team received really really good news on darnold and later added that he hoped they would have a really accurate picture of a plan of attack by monday veteran drew lock would be in line to start seattle s week 2 game against the cardinals if darnold is unable to play lock went 16 of 22 for 187 yards with one touchdown in relief of darnold against new england

news_mentions.headline: Browns sticking with Deshaun Watson as starting QB for Week 2 game vs. Buccaneers
news_mentions.description: Despite a dismal season-opening performance, Browns coach Todd Monken is sticking with Deshaun Watson as his starting quarterback for Week 2 against the Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: despite a dismal season opening performance cleveland browns coach todd monken is sticking with deshaun watson as his starting quarterback for week 2 against the tampa bay buccaneers i anticipate deshaun will be our starter monken said monday watson finished 16 of 22 passing for 205 yards with a first drive interception and a final drive 46 yard touchdown pass in a hoping a trip to tampa can

news_mentions.headline: Rams' Sean McVay: No timeline on Myles Garrett's return post knee surgery
news_mentions.description: News broke Sunday that Myles Garrett would undergo knee surgery and land on injured reserve, which will knock him out a minimum of four weeks. He could be out longer depending on how the knee responds.
news_mentions.body_text: the los angeles rams won t set a timeline for myles garrett s return following monday s knee surgery i don t really have a timeline yet head coach sean mcvay told reporters on monday it s all contingent upon how do things go today you feel good about it but i think it d be unfair to him or really just without having the totality of all the information to put any sort of timeline on it we know that he ll be available in four weeks potentially so we ll just take that a day at a time news broke sunday that garrett will undergo knee surgery and land on injured reserve which will knock him out a minimum of four weeks he could be out longer depending on how the knee responds garrett played in last week s season opener in australia generating five pressures but failing to record a sack or a tackle the pass rusher admitted after the game that he wasn t himself and was concerned about his knee which had limited him during training camp mcvay said he knew immediately following the game that garrett would have to go on ir it was right after the game mcvay said honestly after i talked with him after the game after i d spoken with you guys and just seeing just how he felt you look at it we thought it was something that we d be able to kinda manage that wasn t necessarily the case so having that evidence and being able to say what s the next right thing it was right after the game just in terms of listening to how he felt how he was able to impact the game and even just like what you guys saw with how limited we had to be with him obviously we thought we were doing the right thing but in hindsight you ll always be able to learn from it the decision to play garrett who came over in a ballyhooed trade with the cleveland browns despite nursing the knee injury throughout training camp sat juxtaposed to that of aaron donald who didn t play week 1 after returning from a two year absence mcvay noted that the two situations were completely different the direction that we went with myles and the direction we went with aaron are two totally separate situations and circumstances he said with myles it was more along the lines of we had been aware of this thought it was something that he d be able to work through obviously being out there and playing in a real game you learn like hey maybe that s not the case so let s change course with that with aaron it was more just getting him up to speed mcvay said the club isn t sure if donald will play week 2 in prime time versus the 1 0 new york giants on sept 21 we haven t decided that yet mcvay said of donald he s gonna continue to work his process and we ll see what it looks like if donald isn t able to play a once vaunted looking defensive front on paper will be rather thin on the field

news_mentions.headline: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane to miss several weeks with fractured wrist
news_mentions.description: Baltimore Ravens receiver Ja'Kobi Lane suffered a fractured wrist in Sunday's win over the Colts and will miss several weeks.
news_mentions.body_text: ja 39 kobi lane s promising start with the baltimore ravens has hit a speed bump out of the gate lane suffered a fractured wrist in the ravens 41 23 win over the indianapolis colts and is expected to miss several weeks nfl network insiders mike garafolo and ian rapoport reported sunday night lane will undergo future testing to determine the full extent of the ailment it s a tough blow for lane and the ravens who also lost top wideout zay flowers to a hamstring injury in the victory rapoport reported monday morning that flowers injury isn t considered serious lane s first nfl game saw him register one catch on three targets for 11 yards the ravens swooped on lane in the third round of the 2026 nfl draft and the usc product quickly grew buzz during the offseason and training camp work now he ll have to rebound from an injury and so too will the ravens devontez walker was inactive with a groin injury sunday and now with lane out for multiple weeks baltimore will need bigger contributions from lajohntay wester and chris moore from an already thin wr room the ravens 1 0 host the new orleans saints 0 1 on week 2 sunday

news_mentions.headline: Vikings QB Kyler Murray suffers concussion in first quarter of win over Packers
news_mentions.description: Minnesota Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray suffered a concussion in Sunday's  39-22 win over the Green Bay Packers and did not return.
news_mentions.body_text: minnesota vikings quarterback kyler murray suffered a concussion in sunday s 39 22 win over the green bay packers and did not return on a third and 7 scramble in the first quarter murray slid but took a big hit from packers defenders lukas van ness and javon bullard murray s helmet came off on the play and the veteran qb remained on the turf at u s bank stadium before eventually walking off under his own power and exiting to the locker room i have no update on how those evaluations have gone head coach kevin o connell said after the game we ll take it day by day and see how he comes in tomorrow o connell added that murray seemed to be doing well after the game but i wouldn t medically quote me on that bullard was flagged for unnecessary roughness on the play to prolong the vikings drive murray was just 11 plays into his debut with the vikings before exiting and went 3 of 5 for 18 yards with an interception carson wentz took over under center for minnesota going 12 of 19 for 133 yards with three touchdowns to lead the vikings to a comeback win

news_mentions.headline: Ravens RB Derrick Henry passes Marcus Allen for third on all-time rushing TD list
news_mentions.description: Baltimore Ravens RB Derrick Henry rushed for two touchdowns during the first half of Sunday's win over the Indianapolis Colts to move into third all-time on the league's rushing TD list.
news_mentions.body_text: another season another year derrick henry appears set to defy father time the baltimore ravens running back rushed for two touchdowns during the first half of sunday s season opening 41 23 win over the indianapolis colts to move into third all time on the league s rushing td list he later added a third touchdown to cement another career day in his likely hall of fame career henry now has 125 career scores on the ground two ahead of hall of famer marcus allen 123 love marcus allen henry said after the game he s a great dude and for my name to be mentioned over his is an honor i m very grateful his record breaking score came in vintage henry fashion as he rumbled through the colts defense for an explosive 32 yard td to contribute to a 31 point first half for first year coach jesse minter henry finished with 144 yards on 24 carries as baltimore moved to 1 0

news_mentions.headline: Memorable first games in active NFL stadiums: Giants-Cowboys thriller at Jerry World tops list
news_mentions.description: With the Buffalo Bills opening the new Highmark Stadium on Thursday night, Jeremy Bergman takes a trip down memory lane, ranking the five most memorable first games in active NFL stadiums.
news_mentions.body_text: another opening another shnow thursday night marks a momentous day for the buffalo bills as they play their first regular season game in their new home with the same name as their old home highmark stadium this highmark stadium is a 2 2 billion behemoth flush with massive bison statues out front a view of the buffalo skyline from the upper deck in orchard park and a new head coach a younger model of course the headlines leading into thursday evening s housewarming with the detroit lions skew skeptical of the new digs some fans attending the stadium s public unveiling noted that their sightlines were obstructed earlier this month the grounds crew had to replace the field s actual field after players noted clumps of the turf were coming up during preseason games but the best way to get rid of negative press is to create positive memories or at least memorable moments the most recent stadium debuts didn t get that opportunity the rams and chargers opened sofi stadium and the raiders debuted allegiant stadium back in 2020 in the midst of the covid 19 outbreak attendance was heavily restricted across the league with essentially zero fans present in inglewood california and las vegas leading players to gesture toward empty seats and cutouts after scoring touchdowns and snagging interceptions that won t be the case in buffalo where bills mafia is sure to provide a hearty welcome to their beloved boys in blue and a hostile reception to the visitors if bills fans are seeking inspiration for how an nfl stadium debut should go i ve got them covered after compiling the top stadium farewells last season for buffalo s au revoir to the ralph i ve ranked the most memorable first games in active nfl stadiums not counting highmark sofi and allegiant there are 27 to choose from a number of openings were absolute duds the browns returning to cleveland with a 43 0 loss to pittsburgh in 1999 the oilers and jaguars combining for 125 passing yards in duval in 95 but we ve also experienced some rousing affairs so here s the breakdown starting with the toughest omissions and one oddity then continuing on to the top five countdown just missed the cut lambeau field new city stadium green bay packers packers 21 bears 17 week 1 1957 northwest stadium jack kent cooke stadium washington commanders washington 19 arizona 13 ot week 3 1997 m t bank stadium ravens stadium at camden yards baltimore ravens steelers 20 ravens 13 week 1 1998 raymond james stadium tampa bay buccaneers buccaneers 27 bears 15 week 3 1998 lincoln financial field philadelphia eagles buccaneers 17 eagles 0 week 1 2003 levi s stadium san francisco 49ers bears 28 49ers 20 week 2 2014 honorable mention hard rock stadium miami dolphins opened 1987 as joe robbie stadium first game dolphins 42 chiefs 0 week 5 1987 memorable plays liffort hobley and trell hooper s 50 plus yard fumble return touchdowns within three minutes of each other in the third quarter miami had the misfortune of playing its first regular season home game since moving from the historic orange bowl during the 1987 players strike the dolphins were originally scheduled to open their new stadium in miami gardens against the reigning champion giants but their week 3 matchup was cancelled due to the onset of the strike two weeks later with replacement players on the roster miami hosted kansas city for a bizarre home opening in a stadium with a capacity upwards of 70 000 just under 26 000 attended the dolphins as they were were quarterbacked not by dan marino but by kyle mackey an 11th round pick of the st louis cardinals in the 1984 nfl draft little was needed of mackey as ronald scott a running back out of southern carried the day scoring the only three touchdowns of his nfl career on 18 carries he got the start the following week and never played another game in the league miami s defense helped matters with two 50 plus yard scoops and scores in the third quarter throttling a chiefs offense led by alex espinoza who completed nine of 14 attempts for 69 yards in his only career nfl outing the game is only memorable in that it was unique fans of the era will barely even recall it because the contest was partially blacked out in the miami and kansas city areas due to low attendance figures and a non competitive finish poor dick enberg and merlin olsen quotable from behind the glass of his private box joe robbie himself waved imperially down upon his flock if he counted heads and didn t find enough to meet the mortgage it wasn t showing sunday one of the most memorable days in south florida sports history he proclaimed arrogantly disregarding the truths of the day south florida sun sentinel 5 soldier field chicago bears opened 1924 1971 as bears full time home first game bears 17 steelers 15 week 1 1971 memorable play kent nix s game winning td pass to george farmer in the fourth quarter the bears very first game at soldier field was so long ago that anyone in attendance would be at the very least 100 years old at time of publication not so memorable i guess was the bears 10 0 shutout win over the crosstown cardinals in week 9 of the 1926 campaign no offense to coach george halas duke hanny paddy driscoll and milt romney really but the first bears game after moving south from wrigley field to soldier field their new permanent residence was a doozy well for at least one quarter facing chuck noll and terry bradshaw s steelers one year pre immaculate reception the bears went down 15 3 in the fourth unable to stop john fuqua and warren bankston on the ground but later in the quarter bankston fumbled on two consecutive drives the first fell to ross brupbacher who ran the pigskin back 30 yards to the end zone the second was forced by the great dick butkus who also picked off bradshaw on the day and the bears got the ball back in position to score trailing by five points coach jim dooley then replaced starting qb jack concannon with kent nix who picked up a first down with his legs and then tossed his lone completion of the game to george farmer for an 8 yard td connection it was merely a moment in time for nix who ended up starting four games in 71 despite completing 37 2 of his passes on the year but he ll always be remembered as the qb who pioneered the bears first victory at their forever home quotable the most heartsick fans in the sports world today must be those among the record bear home crowd of 55 049 who left yesterday s game in rainy soldier field five minutes early oh ye of so little faith cooper rollow chicago tribune 4 reliant stadium houston texans opened 2002 first game texans 19 cowboys 10 week 1 2002 memorable play david carr s 65 yard td pass to corey bradford in the fourth quarter the nfl s first true expansion team in seven years and still the most recent one the houston texans enjoyed arguably the most emphatic first game in nfl history with no 1 overall pick david carr under center the texans franchise welcomed the nfl back to houston in a prime time showcase against america s team the in state rival dallas cowboys jerry jones was happy to share the spotlight with texans owner bob mcnair for only a few minutes before his boys fell behind built just next to the astrodome which was vacated by the oilers turned titans after the 1996 season reliant stadium was rocking after carr delivered a td strike to billy miller less than 75 seconds into the game and the party never stopped even after carr found corey bradford streaking down the right sideline in a tie ballgame in the fourth quarter hitting him in the hands just ahead of darren woodson and leading bradford into the end zone for what would be a game winning 65 yard td pass houston sealed the deal with a safety of quincy carter to become the first expansion team to win its debut since minnesota achieved the feat in 1961 since that fateful day the texans haven t quite taken over the cowboys position as the face of professional football in texas but they ve made their mark winning eight afc south titles over the past 15 years it all started with the energy brought at reliant stadium on that opening night quotable for almost the entire game it was difficult to tell who was the expansion team and who was america s team john mcclain houston chronicle 3 ford field detroit lions opened 2002 first game packers 37 lions 31 week 3 2002 memorable play az zahir hakim s 72 yard punt return touchdown to open up the scoring the lions brought nfl football back to downtown detroit in 2002 after nearly three decades at the silverdome in pontiac and their re introduction was a classic hosting brett favre and the hated packers the lions led by first round pick joey heisman harrington in his first start went toe to toe with the eventual nfc north champions this rivalry bout was littered with big plays it opened with an az zahir hakim 72 yard reverse punt return td for detroit followed by a marques anderson 78 yard pick six for green bay favre then threw a td pass to future pro bowler donald driver harrington responded with a 39 yard scoring strike to lamont warren before halftime after a big start to the second half pushed the packers to a 34 17 lead detroit responded with two touchdowns including a 52 yard james stewart scamper after the two minute warning following a green bay field goal harrington got the ball back with just over a minute left embracing his hero s moment harrington drove detroit inside green bay s 35 yard line but after the no 3 overall pick just missed mikhael ricks over the top harrington threw a game sealing interception his fourth of the day in the middle of the field cementing detroit s first loss to the packers at ford field quotable and the honeymoon s over green bay 37 detroit 31 the season is still winless the defense is still porous and we re out of new stadiums mitch albom detroit free press 2 nissan stadium tennessee titans opened 1999 as adelphia coliseum first game titans 36 bengals 35 week 1 1999 memorable play al del greco s game winning 33 yard field goal after years in the wilderness of tennessee the titans ne oilers found their identity in 1999 in the confines of adelphia coliseum built on the east bank of the cumberland river in nashville jeff fisher s tennessee oilers spent the 1997 and 98 seasons playing in memphis and at vanderbilt respectively but kicked off what would be an historic 1999 campaign in brand new digs the titans season got off to a hot 26 7 start against the overmatched visitors from cincinnati with steve mcnair and kevin dyson toying with the bengals d for a combined three touchdowns in the first half but the bengals led by a cramping jeff blake stormed back to score 28 straight points inspired newly minted titans fans to boo and carried a 35 26 lead deep into the fourth quarter mcnair then brought the titans back down the field and found eddie george for a 17 yard catch and run score after a tennessee defensive stop mcnair days away from back surgery and george moved the ball from the bengals 49 to the 15 where with 12 seconds to go al del greco sent cheering titans fans home victorious with a game sealing 33 yard field goal tennessee surrendered 35 plus points again only twice over its remaining 19 games losing just four times including a heartbreakingly close defeat to the rams in super bowl xxxiv as for the bengals bruce coslet s boys won just one of their next 10 games yet for one sunday afternoon in september the eventual afc champions and afc central afterthoughts were one point apart this season the newly rebranded titans are set to play their final regular season game in adelphia coliseum now named nissan stadium against another former afc central rival in the steelers could another streaky shootout be in the offing quotable the booing gave me even more motivation to go out and get the job done i don t understand it but the team surrounded me and said don t worry and we came out on top that s what counts steve mcnair via the associated press 1 at t stadium dallas cowboys opened 2009 as cowboys stadium first game giants 33 cowboys 31 week 1 2009 memorable play eli manning s tipped third down conversion to mario manningham followed by lawrence tynes game winning field goal it doesn t get bigger than the opening of jerry world the debut of cowboys stadium in 2009 was a monumental culture event attended by former president george w bush and over 105 000 spectators the game delivered on the occasion the cowboys and archrival giants less than two years removed from their fateful divisional round clash at texas stadium went back and forth all sunday night trading points and crazy plays there was bruce johnson s 34 yard pick six of tony romo in the first quarter kenny phillips interception off a deflection off jason witten s heel in the second mario manningham s juggling 22 yard td grab in the final minute of the half felix jones 56 yard run in the third and eli manning s game winning drive in the fourth that march which came after dallas went up 31 30 with 3 40 to go ate up the rest of the clock with manning connecting with kevin boss steve smith and manningham for four first downs with four seconds left on the clock and after a wade phillips icing of the kicker lawrence tynes booted home a 37 yard field goal to seal the win for big blue and spoil the cowboys grand opening jones may not have enjoyed the result but surely appreciated eight lead changes worth of entertainment quotable we appreciate 100 000 people cheering us on we enjoyed watching ourselves on the tv giants linebacker antonio pierce via the new york times

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying
