performance center eagan minnesota fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs houston texans saturday aug 9 at 4 p m et nfl network week 2 vs new england patriots saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 at tennessee titans friday aug 22 at 8 p m et cbs 2025 schedule note the vikings will be the first team in nfl history to play a game in multiple international countries in the same season week 4 in ireland and week 5 in england nfl research what you need to know 1 it s all about j j mccarthy in minnesota the second year quarterback will be under the microscope as he takes over an offense that rejuvenated sam darnold s career last season the vikings decided not to buffer mccarthy with a veteran backup after daniel jones opted to sign with indianapolis apologies to the sam howell stans but he s not a threat to mccarthy the former first round pick inherited the porsche of offenses which has made almost every driver look good kevin o connell is a proven qb whisperer so the assumption is that mccarthy should have little trouble keeping things afloat with justin jefferson jordan addison t j hockenson and a remade offensive line the vikes offer weapons to aid the young signal caller minnesota is a 14 win club that on paper improved entering 2025 the loudest question is mccarthy and whether he can keep the engine humming after missing all of 2024 it s not hyperbole to suggest that mccarthy is the pendulum that could swing the course of the entire nfc north 2 the top camp battle in minnesota comes in the secondary heretofore the vikings have yet to add a veteran to the mix who could push for a starting gig next to byron murphy it feels as though the club could be waiting to see how mekhi blackmon bounces back after missing the entire 2024 season due to an acl tear isaiah rodgers blackmon and jeff okudah are in line to battle for the cb2 role elsewhere in the vikings secondary the club didn t replace no 3 safety camryn bynum who left for indianapolis this offseason defensive coordinator brian flores used three safeties liberally last season if he does so again would he trust the likes of theo jackson in that role could a veteran be added closer to the season 3 will the interior offensive line upgrades pay off the internal pressure proved to be sam darnold s undoing last year general manager kwesi adofo mensah set out to fix the issue signing veterans ryan kelly and will fries from indy then he drafted guard donovan jackson in the first round in theory the moves should solidify a leaky interior however kelly and fries are both coming off injury plagued seasons those concerns are coupled with star left tackle christian darrisaw coming off a season ending knee injury the offseason overhaul is excellent from a starter s perspective but there are questions among the second string crew should injuries strike again

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the detroit lions offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 16 rookies july 19 veterans location detroit lions training facility allen park michigan fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule pro football hall of fame game vs los angeles chargers thursday july 31 at 8 p m et nbc week 1 at atlanta falcons friday aug 8 at 7 p m et week 2 vs miami dolphins saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 vs houston texans saturday aug 23 at 1 p m et 2025 schedule note the lions have 11 games against 2024 playoff teams tied with the eagles for most in the nfl nfl research what you need to know 1 who will replace frank ragnow the abrupt retirement of the star center tossed a massive question mark into the lions den presumably the club hoped to get one more year out of the stalwart pivot who played through an assortment of injuries throughout his career that would have allowed rookie tate ratledge to get his feet wet at guard before transitioning to center in 2026 much the same way ragnow started his career now things are turned topsy turvy is the second round rookie ready to start under center like 30 other second round picks he remains unsigned as camp approaches which could toss another kink into the lions plans can veteran graham glasgow return to center for the start of the season the 32 year old struggled last season at guard and hasn t consistently played center since the end of the 2022 campaign fifth round rookie miles frazier could also play a key role this season particularly if injuries strike with second year guard christian mahogany already slated to take over for guard kevin zeitler who left in free agency the lions could be uber young in the middle of the offensive line in front of jared goff a strength of the 2024 squad the offensive line has big questions heading into training camp 2 coming off a 15 2 season and back to back nfc north championships the lions are replacing both coordinators who left for head coaching jobs dan campbell knew he could trust ben johnson and aaron glenn to pull the right plays and build a reliable game plan week in and week out now he ll have to construct that same trust with new offensive coordinator john morton and defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard working under glenn since he became an nfl coach in 2021 sheppard was a natural choice to step into the dc role however he s green as a play caller and there will be questions about how he handles in game adjustments glenn kept a defense decimated by injuries afloat last season until the playoffs how would sheppard fare if similar devastation occurs likewise morton enters with big shoes to fill the lions offense was a dual threat nightmare for defenses and johnson was a master at setting up defenses to fail will morton who doesn t have a ton of play calling experience continue that with a trove of offensive weapons or could we see a step back from detroit s offense morton s familiarity with goff is a benefit but questions remain as to how he ll tweak the scheme like potentially splitting out wide jahmyr gibbs more often it s difficult to imagine the lions getting better management from their coordinators than they had a year ago any step back could be a detriment in a tough division training camp will give us our first real taste of how the new coordinators plan to change things or not in 2025 3 aidan hutchinson has been cleared from last year s devastating injury given the timeline it s not a surprise that the pass rusher is raring to go but it will be good to see him live during camp how he attacks those first few days of practice and recovers from them will give a good indication as to whether he can get back to the defensive player of the year trajectory he was on pre injury or whether we should curtail our expectations hutchinson s health isn t the only one to track in detroit alim mcneill is expected to miss the early part of the season but how much remains to be seen how does marcus davenport look after yet another injury shortened season there are questions at edge rusher in detroit so the health of the front four is particularly notable at this early stage

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon

across the nfc south catch up on the carolina panthers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 21 rookies july 22 veterans location bank of america stadium charlotte north carolina fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs cleveland browns 7 p m et nfl network on friday aug 8 week 2 at houston texans 1 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs pittsburgh steelers 7 p m et nfl network on thursday aug 21 2025 schedule note the panthers are one of just seven teams that do not have a thursday game on their schedule their monday night matchup with san francisco in week 12 is currently slated to be their only prime time game of the 2025 regular season nfl research what you need to know 1 bryce young s growth in the last half of 2024 was the silver lining of yet another lost season in carolina and furthering his development will be a primary focus over training camp the panthers helped that cause in april with the first round selection of tetairoa mcmillan who possesses the typical traits of a true no 1 wide receiver and offers young a rangy target as the quarterback enters year 3 establishing chemistry with mcmillan is crucial for an immediate impact and having veteran adam thielen around figures to aid that process xavier legette s development entering his second season is also essential to forming a dynamic group weapons for young to utilize hunter renfrow s comeback attempt in carolina is another subplot to keep an eye on over the summer as the panthers aim to build around their franchise quarterback 2 derrick brown s return in 2025 won t be only thing to anticipate for the panthers defense defensive linemen tershawn wharton and bobby brown are key free agent additions joining carolina s star defender and the initial gelling of this reimagined defensive front is worth monitoring the panthers lacked any push without brown who suffered a season ending knee injury in week 1 and their run stopping troubles spiraled into last season s 32nd ranked defense a turnaround up front could do wonders for a unit with a talented secondary headed by jaycee horn and mike jackson the panthers also added pass rusher patrick jones and safety tre 39 von moehrig via free agency rookies nic scourton and lathan ransom are also in the mix for playing time 3 kickoff and punt returns might bring some added excitement along carolina s preseason both primary roles are up for grabs this summer and a pair of rookies wr jimmy horn and running back trevor etienne are expected to compete for both jobs the pairing is small in size but brings plenty of speed and shiftiness to a club that has produced just one touchdown return since 2018 the panthers oncoming work on special teams doesn t stop with figuring out the returners either with new kickers matthew wright and ryan fitzgerald battling for the starting role and new punter sam martin holding for longtime long snapper j j jansen

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc east catch up on the philadelphia eagles offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies veterans location novacare complex philadelphia fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs cincinnati bengals 7 30 p m et on thursday aug 7 week 2 vs cleveland browns 1 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 at new york jets 7 30 p m et on friday aug 22 2025 schedule note the eagles are the only team currently scheduled to play on five or more days of the week during the 2025 regular season sunday monday thursday friday saturday the chargers are set to play on four different days with the possibility of a fifth if their week 17 game currently tbd takes place on saturday nfl research what you need to know 1 there aren t many holes on the eagles roster entering the 2025 season that s what you d expect from the reigning super bowl champions with one of the youngest nuclei in football but there are a number of questions to be answered on the defensive side of the ball after a slew of departures out are josh sweat oren burks darius slay and chauncey gardner johnson four super bowl starters plus milton williams and the retired brandon graham that s 4 070 combined defensive snaps regular season and postseason and a lot of experience for which to compensate even for roster building whiz howie roseman and defensive guru vic fangio philly has backfilled well with its own talent plus a few notable additions in first rounder jihaad campbell pass rushers josh uche and azeez ojulari and cornerback adoree 39 jackson but how and how quickly the new look unit gels will be the focus of camp 2 what does saquon barkley s sequel look like after his historic 2 000 yard debut season with the eagles the madden nfl 26 cover athlete has reached the pinnacle of his sport with not much left to conquer the super bowl champ s renegotiated 20 6m aav deal is now the most expensive ever for a running back philly returns the same offense this season priming barkley for another opportunity to gash defenses behind arguably the league s top offensive line the eagles will likely lighten the star rb s load in training camp and preseason potentially save for an aug 13 joint practice with cleveland but if he shows the same burst and ability after an offseason of celebration could we be looking at our first two time 2k rusher 3 the eagles boast great continuity on the offensive roster but they ll have a new play caller and coordinator in 2025 kevin patullo was promoted to offensive coordinator after kellen moore left to be the saints head coach essentially minutes after their super bowl victory patullo will be philly s fourth offensive coordinator in as many years under nick sirianni shane steichen left for indy after the 2022 campaign and brian johnson was bounced after 23 the annual turnover at oc is historic sirianni is the first head coach to have four different ocs excluding interims in a four season span for one team since the merger and yet the eagles offense remains remarkably proficient year to year will that change with patullo s elevation he s been around the team since 2021 through the highs and lows of two super bowl berths and one embarrassing collapse our first glimpse at philly s identity under patullo will come in camp this summer

material_news_signals.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 2: Caleb Williams, Lamar Jackson and Trevor Lawrence soar into top five
material_news_signals.description: Movement abounds in Nick Shook's QB Index, with prolific passers like Trevor Lawrence flying up the rankings as scattershot signal-callers like Drake Maye plummet. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: i begin this qb index with a disclaimer with only one week s worth of evidence there is more volatility than usual reputation matters but so do recent results we re a long way from solidifying the standing of many of these quarterbacks and because we saw some unexpected outcomes in week 1 prepare yourself for some aggressive swings it ll even out eventually for now i have one bit of advice buckle up note up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 1 qb index tier 1 josh allen nearly blew buffalo s chances of scoring a huge week 1 win with an inexplicable yolo ball into the end zone late in the fourth quarter but houston cb kamari lassiter dropped the potential game sealing pick now that i ve put that on the record allow me to acknowledge that allen was otherwise marvelous in this contest he played all the allen hits in the bills 36 31 win he scored a rushing touchdown on a wild scramble connected with dj moore on a 43 yard touchdown pass scored another rushing touchdown from a yard out and directed a 96 yard touchdown drive with the game on the line capping it by firing a rocket between two defenders to josh palmer for the game winning score that s a great start to his annual mvp push next gen stats insight via nfl pro allen averaged 12 6 air yards per attempt his highest mark in a game since week 18 of 2022 and he was efficient pushing the ball downfield completing 11 of 16 attempts of 10 plus air yards for 286 yards and two touchdowns caleb williams remains one of the most thrilling joyous watches in the nfl he makes throws nobody else is capable of completing on a weekly basis and did so at least twice on sunday dropping a laser guided strike over two defenders to cole kmet for a touchdown and heaving an off platform missile to rome odunze to set up another score in the first game of williams third professional season i arrived at a new realization the 24 year old now deeply understands the timing and priorities of ben johnson s scheme and operates comfortably within its structure but much like a great guitarist caleb s artistic improvisation is what makes him special and elevates chicago s offense from very good to fantastic sunday s game included a collection of such examples producing thrills on the ground and through the air that have become part of williams brand next gen stats insight via nfl pro williams reached a top speed of 20 8 mph on his second touchdown run a 29 yard scamper in the final minute of the second quarter of chicago s 59 37 win over carolina lamar jackson raved about declan doyle s offense as a breath of fresh air entering the new season perhaps he should have described it as a hurricane because baltimore destroyed indianapolis on sunday jackson played an integral part throwing for 324 yards by leaning heavily on zay flowers early and distributing the ball fairly evenly after the star wideout left with a hamstring tweak it helped that everything worked for the offense but i won t let derrick henry s 144 yards take away from jackson s performance if this becomes the standard for the ravens expect jackson to own a firm place in the mvp discussion again things looked too easy for trevor lawrence and the jaguars who shredded cleveland s defense all afternoon in jacksonville parker washington jakobi meyers and even brenton strange all renewed their connection with lawrence who picked up right where he left off at the end of the 2025 season tier 2 this ranking isn t entirely based on one week s showing and this is where reputation mixes with results matthew stafford wasn t himself in the rams season opening loss to the 49ers in australia but the reigning nfl mvp wasn t all that awful surprisingly stafford finished with a completion percentage over expected cpoe of 2 5 bryce young played excellently on the other hand and leapfrogs stafford for perhaps the only time all season in fact let s take a second to dive a little deeper into young s performance a typically up and down quarterback young looked confident in his most aggressive game since he threw for 448 yards in carolina s week 11 win over atlanta last season most importantly young finally looked fully comfortable in dave canales offense made decisions with conviction and truly elevated carolina s offense was it enough to keep up with caleb williams bears no but it s worth tracking over the next month because it could heavily influence his contract talks with the panthers if this is a preview of what s to come next gen stats insight via nfl pro young threw for 289 yards and averaged 14 5 yards per attempt against zone coverage compared to 72 yards and 4 2 yards per attempt against man coverage in sunday s loss to chicago now back to the rest of the group patrick mahomes scored a rushing touchdown but it s clear he s not quite back to his old self in the mobility department which didn t help his passing efforts early in monday night s 31 10 win over denver that s fine when kenneth walker is shredding an opposing defense but kansas city can t count on that every week mahomes eventually found a rhythm in the second half and finished the game with a pair of td passes but i didn t expect him to start lighting up defenses through the air instantly this will probably be a slow burn dak prescott joe burrow and jared goff largely looked like themselves but at lower than usual outputs with prescott adding an uncharacteristic interception as a result of a failed throwaway attempt that led to a giants touchdown every quarterback is shaking off some rust in week 1 so there s no cause for alarm brock purdy was incredibly sharp in australia and confidently cooked the rams defense even after losing de zhaun stribling to injury the uncs of the world enjoyed watching him connect with three different thirtysomething receivers for touchdowns and i m sure purdy was happy to have mike evans on his side to start the season next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy tied his career high with seven straight dropbacks when aligned under center no play action in week 1 against the rams completing all seven passes for 76 yards and two touchdowns including a 39 yard strike to demarcus robinson in the second quarter jalen hurts had a classic jalen hurts game in week 1 connecting on a handful of downfield shots while willing philadelphia s offense down the field with well timed scrambles against washington the eagles still need to be more consistent offensively on a per play basis but for one week hurts was able to carry them out of the muck to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 6 of 9 downfield passes 10 air yards for 176 yards and three touchdowns in week 1 against the commanders his yardage on those throws was the eighth highest downfield total of his career while he threw three plus downfield touchdown passes for just the sixth time tier 3 remember how i said there would be some stunning volatility in the rankings this week well we ve reached that portion of the program i couldn t stomach dropping justin herbert any further because he still threw for 200 yards but that interception in the fourth quarter was ghastly and an unnecessary risk which we usually don t see from herbert especially when trying to climb out of a nine point hole tyler shough on the other hand shook off his early mistakes and let it rip in the second half throwing the saints back into a game that seemed destined to end in a lopsided loss i m not afraid to admit how much i m enjoying watching him progress as a starter he s fearless when the pressure is on and is developing a clutch gene that should entertain saints fans throughout 2026 it would be nice if their offense woke up earlier next time though next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 8 of 11 passes against the lions blitz for 79 yards and three touchdowns in the second half and overtime after going just 2 of 7 for 17 yards with an interception and a sack fumble in the first half on downfield passes 10 air yards shough completed 11 of 16 attempts for 261 yards and a touchdown the most such yards by a saints quarterback since drew brees in week 6 2016 c j stroud played really well for most of sunday s close loss to the bills but bookending a good game with lost fumbles will knock you down the qb index jordan love lands in the same category after singlehandedly carrying the packers offense through three quarters then crumbling beneath the pressure applied by brian flores defense it wasn t his fault alone green bay s offensive line struggled significantly with picking up blitzes and stunts but as the director of the offense love needed to be better to stop the meltdown we only saw a handful of plays from sam darnold glute injury who lands ahead of jacoby brissett largely because he wasn t afforded much time to succeed or fail brissett certainly didn t fail powering a hungry cardinals offense by leaning on trey mcbride and even finding marvin harrison for a long completion on arizona s way to stunning the chargers next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett completed 6 of 9 passes for 113 yards 23 9 cpoe on throws over 10 air yards in the cards upset win over the bolts drake maye s decent start completely fell apart in the fourth quarter and two of his three interceptions were solely his fault in terms of starts following an mvp runner up campaign this one will not be remembered fondly next gen stats insight via nfl pro all three of maye s interceptions came on deep attempts 20 plus air yards two more than he threw all last season one maye s interception on new england s final drive lost the patriots 47 9 win probability the most on a single pass attempt of his career geno smith did a lot to prove the raiders nightmarish situation was to blame for his ugly 2025 season benefitting from a strong offensive line in a very professional week 1 outing and kindling a new connection with adonai mitchell that deserves the eyes emoji jaxson dart delivered a similar performance and introduced the world to his new favorite target former ravens tight end and new new york star isaiah likely i m fascinated to see if the giants can sustain this level of success against better defenses than the cowboys revamped unit tier 4 when you sign up for a season with baker mayfield you know you ll have days in which his competitive streak and refusal to surrender will lead to multiple turnovers it happened twice on sunday with the first resulting in a defensive touchdown for the bengals and the second probably costing the buccaneers seven points baker giveth and taketh away but it s probably best it happened in week 1 not week 18 next gen stats insight via nfl pro mayfield averaged 4 7 air yards per attempt fourth fewest in a game in his career and 2 0 air yards per completion third fewest in the 33 27 loss to the bengals he completed 18 of 19 passes under 10 air yards for 134 yards and 5 of 8 passes over 10 air yards for 82 yards jayden daniels produced a mixed bag in philadelphia but the third year pro moved around confidently and delivered in key spots keeping washington in a tight contest that included a nice touchdown pass to stefon diggs and saw daniels lead the commanders on a 12 play 63 yard touchdown drive in crunch time most importantly he exited a pressure packed afternoon healthy next gen stats insight via nfl pro daniels was pressured on 19 of 38 dropbacks in week 1 against the eagles translating to a 50 0 pressure rate that tied his career high week 9 of 2025 vs seattle he went 15 for 19 with 138 yards and a touchdown when throwing from a clean pocket 78 9 completion percentage but just 3 for 15 with 26 yards and a touchdown when under pressure 20 0 aaron rodgers delivered one vintage moment when he rolled left set his feet and fired a bullet to pat freiermuth in the back of the end zone otherwise much of sunday saw rodgers try to force a connection with dk metcalf take many more deep shots than he did last season and finish with a passable at best performance at least he looked more like himself in mike mccarthy s offense next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers 9 2 air yards per target in sunday s 20 13 win over the falcons is the highest figure he has recorded as a member of the steelers with his 2 95 second time to throw mark representing his third highest average in a game with the franchise bo nix produced one truly impressive scoring drive and capped it with a pretty touchdown pass to evan engram to tie monday night s game at 7 7 that was it for the highlights the rest of the night included plenty of lowlights with nix appearing overwhelmed and out of sync amid a hailstorm of pressures generated by steve spagnuolo s defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix was pressured on 45 5 of his dropbacks against the chiefs his second highest pressure rate in a game in his career nix finished 2 of 10 for 5 yards and an interception under pressure with two strip sacks compared to 15 of 18 for 126 yards and a touchdown from a clean pocket kirk cousins played fine football against the lowly dolphins took what miami s defense gave him kept drives moving and finished three with touchdown tosses which meets the standard of expectation for him it also helped that raiders rb ashton jeanty became the dolphins most important problem cousins age showed in his performance though with the 38 year old throwing a couple of ugly interceptions and one dirt ball that saddened me because of how the man fell without getting touched as he threw it i think the wait for no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza won t last all that long daniel jones didn t move as much as usual in his first game back from a season ending achilles injury but it was difficult to put too much stock in his performance given how quickly the ravens buried the colts in a three score deficit he showed some rust in his decision making too forcing a pass into a window that didn t exist with roquan smith lurking underneath in coverage resulting in an interception malik willis did some nice things but was up and down at best and is clearly still acclimating to life as a full time starter his mobility is a weapon and helped him score a rushing touchdown he threw a handful of pretty passes and never looked especially overwhelmed he also threw a groaner of an interception and wasn t able to elevate the dolphins offense as they ll need him to in order to compete this season as far as debuts go it was passable given the surrounding circumstances but there s plenty of room to improve tier 5 kyler murray s debut in minnesota didn t last long included an interception on his first pass attempt a desperation heave fired under instant pressure and ended when he slid at the end of a short scramble was hit late drawing a flag and suffered a concussion leaving me with almost nothing to evaluate in the few snaps he saw prior to exiting there wasn t much to like cam ward s first game in brian daboll s offense was not the dream many fans hoped for the absence of a running game and ineffective pass protection limited ward who didn t handle the challenges well this process will take some time and will definitely include growing pains there were plenty in sunday s 23 10 loss to the jets next gen stats insight via nfl pro ward faced pressure on 42 1 of dropbacks the second highest rate of his career 50 in week 1 of 2025 vs denver under pressure ward completed 3 of 10 passes for 17 yards compared to 16 of 22 for 123 yards and a touchdown without pressure cooper rush was only effective on passes behind the line of scrimmage eliminating the downfield threat from atlanta s offense one target zero catches for kyle pitts and funneling the entire falcons attack through bijan robinson that understandably only worked early and once the steelers adjusted rush had nowhere else to turn succumbing to the pressure applied by pittsburgh s defense in an ugly low scoring loss he also didn t face a single man coverage snap somewhat of a slap in the face from the steelers defense which didn t fear rush enough to try to blanket falcons pass catchers in one on one matchups next gen stats insight via nfl pro rush did not complete a pass when pressured and particularly struggled when holding on to the ball for longer than 2 5 seconds completing 6 of 14 attempts for 83 yards while throwing two interceptions deshaun watson s numbers lied to you he looked just as slow to make decisions as he did in the preseason was consistently inaccurate especially when unsettled by the pass rush threw an awful interception on his third attempt of the season ran himself into pressures with remarkably deep pass drops and generally played like a quarterback who hadn t seen regular season action in two years todd monken told reporters he found plenty to like in watson s tape but the only example i can support was his downfield shot to rookie denzel boston for a touchdown in garbage time i think week 2 might be his last shot to prove he s still worth rostering that is unless monken stubbornly keeps rolling with him

news_mentions.headline: Lions vs. Bills: Three must-know storylines for Thursday's Week 2 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: Can Josh Allen be stopped? Will Jahmyr Gibbs run wild? In advance of Thursday's game between the Lions and Bills, Dan Parr provides three storylines you need to know.
news_mentions.body_text: our cup runneth over after a historic week 1 scoring bonanza made hearts flutter around the nfl the schedule makers have gifted us a matchup made in football heaven to kick off week 2 josh allen and the bills are riding the wave of dropping 36 points on the texans who are still viewed i think as one of the nfl s stingiest defenses buffalo returns home to host the lions who nearly blew a 21 point lead before topping the saints in overtime last week in the first ever regular season game at new highmark stadium over the course of the last 50 regular season games the bills and lions are tied for the most wins with 36 apiece per nfl research yet despite their recent success neither squad has been able to get over the proverbial hump both fan bases yearn to see their team win a super bowl for the first time in franchise history and those hopes are as alive as ever heading into thursday night when it comes to early season intrigue it does not get much more enticing than this clash three must know storylines 1 first one to 50 points wins the first game of week 2 is loaded with offensive weaponry featuring the current mvp favorite allen and the offensive player of the year front runner lions rb jahmyr gibbs the bills boast the reigning rushing king james cook while detroit comes to western new york with all pros in wr amon ra st brown and lt penei sewell if you prefer old school defensive slugfests thursday night s offering might cause heartburn while the bills week 1 tour de force in joe brady s debut as head coach was remarkable because of who it came against the vaunted houston defense it s become old hat to see these two squads lighting up scoreboards detroit 29 7 and buffalo 28 8 are the top two teams in points per game over the last 50 regular season contests they have been living at the top for a long time and are showing no signs of coming down from their perch it s possible factors out of their control like playing on a short week will sap at least some of the juice from the high powered attacks the two beleaguered defenses that will take the field on thursday have to hope that s the case 2 can either defense rise to the occasion the bills and lions offenses don t look like they can be stopped but maybe they can be contained detroit did go one full quarter without scoring in week 1 allen accounted for 357 yards of offense and four touchdowns in houston he was up against a defense that allowed the fewest yards and second fewest points of any team in 2025 returning largely intact for 2026 the texans started five pro bowlers from last season including first team all pros will anderson and derek stingley if houston can t slow down allen can any other team it s hard to imagine the lions with a patchwork secondary thanks in part to the injuries to brian branch and kerby joseph causing more of a ruckus than the texans did on defense but they do have front seven all pros in aidan hutchinson and jack campbell detroit s clearest path to pulling off an upset is keeping its defense off the field it can do that by pounding the rock and dominating in time of possession a lane that might be wide open for the lions considering the bills allowed 124 rushing yards to the texans in the opener with gibbs former running mate david montgomery punching in two of his three tds on the ground run defense was a weak spot for buffalo last season when the team gave up 136 2 yards per game ranking 28th in the league thursday will be a huge test for new bills dc jim leonhard because it doesn t appear that first year lions oc drew petzing is holding anything back when it comes to utilizing the game breaking gibbs who had a career high 34 touches in week 1 3 will the lions overcome injury woes going into a matchup against the bills at far less than full strength in the secondary without the aforementioned branch and joseph and on the offensive line is far from ideal but that s the reality detroit is facing on a short week three of the lions five starters on the o line appeared on tuesday s injury report with rt blake miller knee and lg christian mahogany hip not practicing playing on thursday without miller mahogany or c juice scruggs who was limited on tuesday would be costly for a detroit team that already has its top center cade mays on injured reserve editor s update miller and mahogany have been ruled out for thursday s game if jared goff s timing and or the blocking for gibbs suffer as a result of the health issues on the front line trying to keep up with allen and co could quickly feel like an impossible task

that deserves the eyes emoji jaxson dart delivered a similar performance and introduced the world to his new favorite target former ravens tight end and new new york star isaiah likely i m fascinated to see if the giants can sustain this level of success against better defenses than the cowboys revamped unit tier 4 when you sign up for a season with baker mayfield you know you ll have days in which his competitive streak and refusal to surrender will lead to multiple turnovers it happened twice on sunday with the first resulting in a defensive touchdown for the bengals and the second probably costing the buccaneers seven points baker giveth and taketh away but it s probably best it happened in week 1 not week 18 next gen stats insight via nfl pro mayfield averaged 4 7 air yards per attempt fourth fewest in a game in his career and 2 0 air yards per completion third fewest in the 33 27 loss to the bengals he completed 18 of 19 passes under 10 air yards for 134 yards and 5 of 8 passes over 10 air yards for 82 yards jayden daniels produced a mixed bag in philadelphia but the third year pro moved around confidently and delivered in key spots keeping washington in a tight contest that included a nice touchdown pass to stefon diggs and saw daniels lead the commanders on a 12 play 63 yard touchdown drive in crunch time most importantly he exited a pressure packed afternoon healthy next gen stats insight via nfl pro daniels was pressured on 19 of 38 dropbacks in week 1 against the eagles translating to a 50 0 pressure rate that tied his career high week 9 of 2025 vs seattle he went 15 for 19 with 138 yards and a touchdown when throwing from a clean pocket 78 9 completion percentage but just 3 for 15 with 26 yards and a touchdown when under pressure 20 0 aaron rodgers delivered one vintage moment when he rolled left set his feet and fired a bullet to pat freiermuth in the back of the end zone otherwise much of sunday saw rodgers try to force a connection with dk metcalf take many more deep shots than he did last season and finish with a passable at best performance at least he looked more like himself in mike mccarthy s offense next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers 9 2 air yards per target in sunday s 20 13 win over the falcons is the highest figure he has recorded as a member of the steelers with his 2 95 second time to throw mark representing his third highest average in a game with the franchise bo nix produced one truly impressive scoring drive and capped it with a pretty touchdown pass to evan engram to tie monday night s game at 7 7 that was it for the highlights the rest of the night included plenty of lowlights with nix appearing overwhelmed and out of sync amid a hailstorm of pressures generated by steve spagnuolo s defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix was pressured on 45 5 of his dropbacks against the chiefs his second highest pressure rate in a game in his career nix finished 2 of 10 for 5 yards and an interception under pressure with two strip sacks compared to 15 of 18 for 126 yards and a touchdown from a clean pocket kirk cousins played fine football against the lowly dolphins took what miami s defense gave him kept drives moving and finished three with touchdown tosses which meets the standard of expectation for him it also helped that raiders rb ashton jeanty became the dolphins most important problem cousins age showed in his performance though with the 38 year old throwing a couple of ugly interceptions and one dirt ball that saddened me because of how the man fell without getting touched as he threw it i think the wait for no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza won t last all that long daniel jones didn t move as much as usual in his first game back from a season ending achilles injury but it was difficult to put too much stock in his performance given how quickly the ravens buried the colts in a three score deficit he showed some rust in his decision making too forcing a pass into a window that didn t exist with roquan smith lurking underneath in coverage resulting in an interception malik willis did some nice things but was up and down at best and is clearly still acclimating to life as a full time starter his mobility is a weapon and helped him score a rushing touchdown he threw a handful of pretty passes and never looked especially overwhelmed he also threw a groaner of an interception and wasn t able to elevate the dolphins offense as they ll need him to in order to compete this season as far as debuts go it was passable given the surrounding circumstances but there s plenty of room to improve tier 5 kyler murray s debut in minnesota didn t last long included an interception on his first pass attempt a desperation heave fired under instant pressure and ended when he slid at the end of a short scramble was hit late drawing a flag and suffered a concussion leaving me with almost nothing to evaluate in the few snaps he saw prior to exiting there wasn t much to like cam ward s first game in brian daboll s offense was not the dream many fans hoped for the absence of a running game and ineffective pass protection limited ward who didn t handle the challenges well this process will take some time and will definitely include growing pains there were plenty in sunday s 23 10 loss to the jets next gen stats insight via nfl pro ward faced pressure on 42 1 of dropbacks the second highest rate of his career 50 in week 1 of 2025 vs denver under pressure ward completed 3 of 10 passes for 17 yards compared to 16 of 22 for 123 yards and a touchdown without pressure cooper rush was only effective on passes behind the line of scrimmage eliminating the downfield threat from atlanta s offense one target zero catches for kyle pitts and funneling the entire falcons attack through bijan robinson that understandably only worked early and once the steelers adjusted rush had nowhere else to turn succumbing to the pressure applied by pittsburgh s defense in an ugly low scoring loss he also didn t face a single man coverage snap somewhat of a slap in the face from the steelers defense which didn t fear rush enough to try to blanket falcons pass catchers in one on one matchups next gen stats insight via nfl pro rush did not complete a pass when pressured and particularly struggled when holding on to the ball for longer than 2 5 seconds completing 6 of 14 attempts for 83 yards while throwing two interceptions deshaun watson s numbers lied to you he looked just as slow to make decisions as he did in the preseason was consistently inaccurate especially when unsettled by the pass rush threw an awful interception on his third attempt of the season ran himself into pressures with remarkably deep pass drops and generally played like a quarterback who hadn t seen regular season action in two years todd monken told reporters he found plenty to like in watson s tape but the only example i can support was his downfield shot to rookie denzel boston for a touchdown in garbage time i think week 2 might be his last shot to prove he s still worth rostering that is unless monken stubbornly keeps rolling with him

news_mentions.headline: NFL Power Rankings, Week 2: Seahawks leapfrog Broncos and Rams into No. 1 spot; Chiefs hit top 10
news_mentions.description: After a high-scoring and highly entertaining opening week of the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook's Power Rankings see significant change, starting right at the top. Check out the full league hierarchy, 1-32, entering Week 2.
news_mentions.body_text: week 1 is complete and as is always the case with the opening weekend of a new season surprises appeared all over the place the cardinals rolled into sofi stadium punched the chargers in the mouth stole their lunch money and ran back to the desert cackling with satisfaction the saints nearly pulled off a legendary comeback in detroit and for yet another year we learned it was unwise to trust the hype surrounding the cowboys who climbed who fell and which of these movers will age poorly in a month s time let s rank all 32 note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 1 edition of the power rankings

news_mentions.headline: Drake Maye channels Bill Belichick after loss to Seahawks: 'We're on to Pittsburgh'
news_mentions.description: Drake Maye threw three fourth-quarter interceptions in New England's Week 1 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: new england patriots quarterback drake maye took a page from bill belichick s book when asked monday about the dastardly end to the season opening loss in seattle we re on to pittsburgh maye said on weei via boston com we ve got another week another chance in this league and that s dealing with the ups and downs in this league that s part of it playing the national football league belichick who left the patriots the year before maye was drafted famously repeated the phrase we re on to cincinnati back in 2014 after an awful early season 41 14 loss to the kansas city chiefs the phrase became a rallying cry as the pats won their next eight games en route to a super bowl championship maye struggled mightily down the stretch of last wednesday s season opener tossing three woeful fourth quarter interceptions including the loss sealing int the third year qb completed 23 of 33 pass attempts for 178 yards one touchdown and a career high three interceptions in week 1 maye was efficient on throws under 10 air yards completing 20 of his 23 such attempts for 134 yards and a td 8 9 cpoe but struggled downfield 10 air yards connecting on just three of eight attempts for 44 yards and three ints 12 7 cpoe per next gen stats despite the dismal outing maye believes the pats offense can turn it around swiftly i think there were plays out there to be made maye said i think we had plays in the run game plays in the passing game where we had opportunities to make big plays and in this league we feel last week the way we approached it was a good plan we were ahead on the score and then in the fourth quarter still had a chance to win the game and send it to overtime at the worst i ve got to be better and i will be better going forward maye aims to improve in week 2 against a steelers defense that feasted on backup falcons qb cooper rush last sunday t j watt was a menace recording his 10th career interception on a fourth quarter pick six the pats offensive line did a better job in week 1 than in the super bowl but if the club is to get off the mat following last week s loss they ll have to protect maye from the steelers formidable pass rush

news_mentions.headline: Memorable first games in active NFL stadiums: Giants-Cowboys thriller at Jerry World tops list
news_mentions.description: With the Buffalo Bills opening the new Highmark Stadium on Thursday night, Jeremy Bergman takes a trip down memory lane, ranking the five most memorable first games in active NFL stadiums.
news_mentions.body_text: another opening another shnow thursday night marks a momentous day for the buffalo bills as they play their first regular season game in their new home with the same name as their old home highmark stadium this highmark stadium is a 2 2 billion behemoth flush with massive bison statues out front a view of the buffalo skyline from the upper deck in orchard park and a new head coach a younger model of course the headlines leading into thursday evening s housewarming with the detroit lions skew skeptical of the new digs some fans attending the stadium s public unveiling noted that their sightlines were obstructed earlier this month the grounds crew had to replace the field s actual field after players noted clumps of the turf were coming up during preseason games but the best way to get rid of negative press is to create positive memories or at least memorable moments the most recent stadium debuts didn t get that opportunity the rams and chargers opened sofi stadium and the raiders debuted allegiant stadium back in 2020 in the midst of the covid 19 outbreak attendance was heavily restricted across the league with essentially zero fans present in inglewood california and las vegas leading players to gesture toward empty seats and cutouts after scoring touchdowns and snagging interceptions that won t be the case in buffalo where bills mafia is sure to provide a hearty welcome to their beloved boys in blue and a hostile reception to the visitors if bills fans are seeking inspiration for how an nfl stadium debut should go i ve got them covered after compiling the top stadium farewells last season for buffalo s au revoir to the ralph i ve ranked the most memorable first games in active nfl stadiums not counting highmark sofi and allegiant there are 27 to choose from a number of openings were absolute duds the browns returning to cleveland with a 43 0 loss to pittsburgh in 1999 the oilers and jaguars combining for 125 passing yards in duval in 95 but we ve also experienced some rousing affairs so here s the breakdown starting with the toughest omissions and one oddity then continuing on to the top five countdown just missed the cut lambeau field new city stadium green bay packers packers 21 bears 17 week 1 1957 northwest stadium jack kent cooke stadium washington commanders washington 19 arizona 13 ot week 3 1997 m t bank stadium ravens stadium at camden yards baltimore ravens steelers 20 ravens 13 week 1 1998 raymond james stadium tampa bay buccaneers buccaneers 27 bears 15 week 3 1998 lincoln financial field philadelphia eagles buccaneers 17 eagles 0 week 1 2003 levi s stadium san francisco 49ers bears 28 49ers 20 week 2 2014 honorable mention hard rock stadium miami dolphins opened 1987 as joe robbie stadium first game dolphins 42 chiefs 0 week 5 1987 memorable plays liffort hobley and trell hooper s 50 plus yard fumble return touchdowns within three minutes of each other in the third quarter miami had the misfortune of playing its first regular season home game since moving from the historic orange bowl during the 1987 players strike the dolphins were originally scheduled to open their new stadium in miami gardens against the reigning champion giants but their week 3 matchup was cancelled due to the onset of the strike two weeks later with replacement players on the roster miami hosted kansas city for a bizarre home opening in a stadium with a capacity upwards of 70 000 just under 26 000 attended the dolphins as they were were quarterbacked not by dan marino but by kyle mackey an 11th round pick of the st louis cardinals in the 1984 nfl draft little was needed of mackey as ronald scott a running back out of southern carried the day scoring the only three touchdowns of his nfl career on 18 carries he got the start the following week and never played another game in the league miami s defense helped matters with two 50 plus yard scoops and scores in the third quarter throttling a chiefs offense led by alex espinoza who completed nine of 14 attempts for 69 yards in his only career nfl outing the game is only memorable in that it was unique fans of the era will barely even recall it because the contest was partially blacked out in the miami and kansas city areas due to low attendance figures and a non competitive finish poor dick enberg and merlin olsen quotable from behind the glass of his private box joe robbie himself waved imperially down upon his flock if he counted heads and didn t find enough to meet the mortgage it wasn t showing sunday one of the most memorable days in south florida sports history he proclaimed arrogantly disregarding the truths of the day south florida sun sentinel 5 soldier field chicago bears opened 1924 1971 as bears full time home first game bears 17 steelers 15 week 1 1971 memorable play kent nix s game winning td pass to george farmer in the fourth quarter the bears very first game at soldier field was so long ago that anyone in attendance would be at the very least 100 years old at time of publication not so memorable i guess was the bears 10 0 shutout win over the crosstown cardinals in week 9 of the 1926 campaign no offense to coach george halas duke hanny paddy driscoll and milt romney really but the first bears game after moving south from wrigley field to soldier field their new permanent residence was a doozy well for at least one quarter facing chuck noll and terry bradshaw s steelers one year pre immaculate reception the bears went down 15 3 in the fourth unable to stop john fuqua and warren bankston on the ground but later in the quarter bankston fumbled on two consecutive drives the first fell to ross brupbacher who ran the pigskin back 30 yards to the end zone the second was forced by the great dick butkus who also picked off bradshaw on the day and the bears got the ball back in position to score trailing by five points coach jim dooley then replaced starting qb jack concannon with kent nix who picked up a first down with his legs and then tossed his lone completion of the game to george farmer for an 8 yard td connection it was merely a moment in time for nix who ended up starting four games in 71 despite completing 37 2 of his passes on the year but he ll always be remembered as the qb who pioneered the bears first victory at their forever home quotable the most heartsick fans in the sports world today must be those among the record bear home crowd of 55 049 who left yesterday s game in rainy soldier field five minutes early oh ye of so little faith cooper rollow chicago tribune 4 reliant stadium houston texans opened 2002 first game texans 19 cowboys 10 week 1 2002 memorable play david carr s 65 yard td pass to corey bradford in the fourth quarter the nfl s first true expansion team in seven years and still the most recent one the houston texans enjoyed arguably the most emphatic first game in nfl history with no 1 overall pick david carr under center the texans franchise welcomed the nfl back to houston in a prime time showcase against america s team the in state rival dallas cowboys jerry jones was happy to share the spotlight with texans owner bob mcnair for only a few minutes before his boys fell behind built just next to the astrodome which was vacated by the oilers turned titans after the 1996 season reliant stadium was rocking after carr delivered a td strike to billy miller less than 75 seconds into the game and the party never stopped even after carr found corey bradford streaking down the right sideline in a tie ballgame in the fourth quarter hitting him in the hands just ahead of darren woodson and leading bradford into the end zone for what would be a game winning 65 yard td pass houston sealed the deal with a safety of quincy carter to become the first expansion team to win its debut since minnesota achieved the feat in 1961 since that fateful day the texans haven t quite taken over the cowboys position as the face of professional football in texas but they ve made their mark winning eight afc south titles over the past 15 years it all started with the energy brought at reliant stadium on that opening night quotable for almost the entire game it was difficult to tell who was the expansion team and who was america s team john mcclain houston chronicle 3 ford field detroit lions opened 2002 first game packers 37 lions 31 week 3 2002 memorable play az zahir hakim s 72 yard punt return touchdown to open up the scoring the lions brought nfl football back to downtown detroit in 2002 after nearly three decades at the silverdome in pontiac and their re introduction was a classic hosting brett favre and the hated packers the lions led by first round pick joey heisman harrington in his first start went toe to toe with the eventual nfc north champions this rivalry bout was littered with big plays it opened with an az zahir hakim 72 yard reverse punt return td for detroit followed by a marques anderson 78 yard pick six for green bay favre then threw a td pass to future pro bowler donald driver harrington responded with a 39 yard scoring strike to lamont warren before halftime after a big start to the second half pushed the packers to a 34 17 lead detroit responded with two touchdowns including a 52 yard james stewart scamper after the two minute warning following a green bay field goal harrington got the ball back with just over a minute left embracing his hero s moment harrington drove detroit inside green bay s 35 yard line but after the no 3 overall pick just missed mikhael ricks over the top harrington threw a game sealing interception his fourth of the day in the middle of the field cementing detroit s first loss to the packers at ford field quotable and the honeymoon s over green bay 37 detroit 31 the season is still winless the defense is still porous and we re out of new stadiums mitch albom detroit free press 2 nissan stadium tennessee titans opened 1999 as adelphia coliseum first game titans 36 bengals 35 week 1 1999 memorable play al del greco s game winning 33 yard field goal after years in the wilderness of tennessee the titans ne oilers found their identity in 1999 in the confines of adelphia coliseum built on the east bank of the cumberland river in nashville jeff fisher s tennessee oilers spent the 1997 and 98 seasons playing in memphis and at vanderbilt respectively but kicked off what would be an historic 1999 campaign in brand new digs the titans season got off to a hot 26 7 start against the overmatched visitors from cincinnati with steve mcnair and kevin dyson toying with the bengals d for a combined three touchdowns in the first half but the bengals led by a cramping jeff blake stormed back to score 28 straight points inspired newly minted titans fans to boo and carried a 35 26 lead deep into the fourth quarter mcnair then brought the titans back down the field and found eddie george for a 17 yard catch and run score after a tennessee defensive stop mcnair days away from back surgery and george moved the ball from the bengals 49 to the 15 where with 12 seconds to go al del greco sent cheering titans fans home victorious with a game sealing 33 yard field goal tennessee surrendered 35 plus points again only twice over its remaining 19 games losing just four times including a heartbreakingly close defeat to the rams in super bowl xxxiv as for the bengals bruce coslet s boys won just one of their next 10 games yet for one sunday afternoon in september the eventual afc champions and afc central afterthoughts were one point apart this season the newly rebranded titans are set to play their final regular season game in adelphia coliseum now named nissan stadium against another former afc central rival in the steelers could another streaky shootout be in the offing quotable the booing gave me even more motivation to go out and get the job done i don t understand it but the team surrounded me and said don t worry and we came out on top that s what counts steve mcnair via the associated press 1 at t stadium dallas cowboys opened 2009 as cowboys stadium first game giants 33 cowboys 31 week 1 2009 memorable play eli manning s tipped third down conversion to mario manningham followed by lawrence tynes game winning field goal it doesn t get bigger than the opening of jerry world the debut of cowboys stadium in 2009 was a monumental culture event attended by former president george w bush and over 105 000 spectators the game delivered on the occasion the cowboys and archrival giants less than two years removed from their fateful divisional round clash at texas stadium went back and forth all sunday night trading points and crazy plays there was bruce johnson s 34 yard pick six of tony romo in the first quarter kenny phillips interception off a deflection off jason witten s heel in the second mario manningham s juggling 22 yard td grab in the final minute of the half felix jones 56 yard run in the third and eli manning s game winning drive in the fourth that march which came after dallas went up 31 30 with 3 40 to go ate up the rest of the clock with manning connecting with kevin boss steve smith and manningham for four first downs with four seconds left on the clock and after a wade phillips icing of the kicker lawrence tynes booted home a 37 yard field goal to seal the win for big blue and spoil the cowboys grand opening jones may not have enjoyed the result but surely appreciated eight lead changes worth of entertainment quotable we appreciate 100 000 people cheering us on we enjoyed watching ourselves on the tv giants linebacker antonio pierce via the new york times

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots
