news_mentions.headline: Falcons HC Kevin Stefanski 'not ruling anybody out' at QB for Week 2 vs. Panthers
news_mentions.description: Atlanta's quarterback situation remains murky at best. Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski is leaving open every possibility at the position for Week 2's home-opener agianst the Carolina Panthers
news_mentions.body_text: atlanta s quarterback situation remains murky at best falcons head coach kevin stefanski is leaving open every possibility at the position for week 2 s home opener against the carolina panthers telling reporters wednesday his staff is not ruling anybody out we will have a quarterback yes for this week stefanski said that includes michael penix tua tagovailoa cooper rush and undrafted rookie jack strand theoretically all could play and it seems mid week stefanski isn t interested in revealing any additional information i m not trying to be coy stefanski said when pressed on whether penix who was inactive for week 1 might become available i m just not ruling anybody out continue to work through it we re all on the same page between myself the medical team mike we ll work through all those things for wednesday s record tagovailoa didn t practice due to an oblique injury he suffered in practice last week penix knee and rush back practiced fully while strand isn t being ruled out as a potential participant on sunday in atlanta per stefanski penix told reporters wednesday that he split first team reps with rush at practice and he wouldn t rule out playing sunday i m working extremely hard penix said adding that he s close to a return from his latest acl injury i m dying to be out there this type of multifaceted update was never part of stefanski s plan entering 2026 the falcons understood they were approaching the new season with expected uncertainty due to penix s recovery from his knee injury and that s why they signed tagovailoa as veteran insurance they didn t foresee tagovailoa beginning camp with an injury prompting atlanta to sign rush out of necessity and suffering another injury just days before the regular season penix s return could solve their problems atlanta isn t going to rush it in september though otherwise stefanski might have to play this game of cat and mouse all season long i think you guys talked to mike and mike will explain what we re doing with the progression as he comes back stefanski explained like i told you guys i feel really good about the plan and where we are i m not gonna get into specific conversations with our players but mike is progressing and doing a good job but we ll see how it goes for now he ll repeat the same lines and remain vague it wouldn t benefit him much to name a starter entering week 2 anyway especially after how uninspiring their offense was in week 1 with rush under center in a 20 13 loss to the pittsburgh steelers eventually though the falcons would like this chatter to subside and certainty to appear under center

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker, Bears RB D'Andre Swift highlight Players of the Week
news_mentions.description: Chicago running back D'Andre Swift and Kansas City running back Kenneth Walker earned Offensive Player of the Week accolades for the first week of the season.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in week 1 each wednesday the league unveils its weekly honor roll see who the players of the week are below afc offensive player of the week in his first game with the chiefs and since winning super bowl mvp for the seahawks walker stole the show as he propelled kansas city to an impressive 31 0 victory over the broncos walker posted a career best 173 rushing yards on 23 carries with a 60 yard highlight reel touchdown run included and added a td reception his 191 scrimmage yards were also a career high and the most for a reigning super bowl mvp in week 1 breaking hall of famer jerry rice s 1989 record of 180 this is walker s first player of the week accolade since earning nfc offensive honors in week 3 2023 nfc offensive player of the week swift was a driving force in chicago s scoring parade sunday as the bears blasted the panthers 59 37 swift ran wild to the tune of 124 yards and three touchdowns on 18 carries swift had a pair of 1 yard scores before putting the finishing touches on the scorefest with a 28 yard run to the house this is swift s second career player of the week accolade and his first with the bears afc defensive player of the week for the ninth time in his stellar career but the first time since week 8 2024 watt has earned dpow the recognition comes after he stuffed the box score in a 20 13 win sunday over the falcons highlighted by a 35 yard interception return for a touchdown the first of his career watt s outing saw him generate four tackles three for loss two qb hits and two sacks nfc defensive player of the week in the eagles narrow 24 22 win over the commanders baun was a tackling machine posting 12 tackles in total he also had two pass breakups and one tackle for loss as he garnered his second career defensive player of the week accolade afc special teams player of the week in cincinnati s 33 27 win over tampa bay on sunday mcpherson simply piled on the points the kicker racked up 15 in total as he was perfect on three extra points and four field goals 20 55 58 32 after the bengals jumped out to a 21 7 lead mcpherson s four field goals closed out his squad s scoring mcpherson s now been named afc special teams player of the week five times nfc special teams player of the week fehoko played a pivotal role in the cardinals 26 14 win over the chargers on sunday with the cards lead cut to 16 14 fehoko came up huge with a blocked punt two plays later arizona increased its lead with a trey mcbride touchdown in his sixth nfl season with his third club fehoko is taking home his first player of the week honor

news_mentions.headline: Mike McGlinchey on loss to Chiefs: Broncos must 'flush it as fast as possible'
news_mentions.description: The defending AFC West champion Denver Broncos got walloped by the Kansas City Chiefs, 31-10, on Monday night.
news_mentions.body_text: the kansas city chiefs embarrassed the defending afc west champion denver broncos in week 1 s 31 10 shellacking at arrowhead stadium denver got bullied in every phase of the game the offense was in sync for one series the entire game bo nix was rattled never looking comfortable and made some ghastly mistakes the offensive line a strength got beat particularly by k c s young players the defense was woeful missed 28 tackles and was bulldozed by kenneth walker all denver can do is move on you ve got to take it for what it is right tackle mike mcglinchey said tuesday via the team s official website you ve got to take it you ve got to learn from it you ve got to flush it as fast as possible after our meetings today and move on to the next opponent the broncos were held to just 176 total yards of offense in davis webb s debut as denver s play caller in week 1 the fewest yards for the broncos in sean payton s tenure as head coach per next gen stats the last time denver had fewer yards was week 16 2021 when the drew lock led broncos only had 158 yards against the raiders if the offense continues to look disjointed it won t be long before payton takes back play calling from webb one game doesn t define our season or who we are mcglinchey said we ve just got to learn how to get better from it the defense fared no better than the offense with the 28 missed tackles accounting for 247 yards for k c the most yards allowed by any defense on missed tackles in a game since at least 2018 per ngs eight different defenders missed multiple tackles on the night the task gets no easier for denver with afc south champs jacksonville jaguars who looked good week 1 the los angeles rams san francisco 49ers los angeles chargers and seattle seahawks on tap over the next five weeks when you can remove the emotion and the things and the expectations of what we wanted to do versus what we did you can see it from a clear lens of why the mistakes were made what situations did we put ourselves in and how do we not put ourselves in that position moving forward mcglinchey said and i think every opportunity is a way to learn win lose or draw if you re not learning you re not growing and you re not going to be successful flush the feelings that you have today flush the embarrassment flush all that stuff and then just get onto the task at hand and take it at face value which is we have a job to do and we have to figure out how to do that job well if denver doesn t flush the loss quickly their season could be the next thing circling the toilet

news_mentions.headline: Drake Maye channels Bill Belichick after loss to Seahawks: 'We're on to Pittsburgh'
news_mentions.description: Drake Maye threw three fourth-quarter interceptions in New England's Week 1 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: new england patriots quarterback drake maye took a page from bill belichick s book when asked monday about the dastardly end to the season opening loss in seattle we re on to pittsburgh maye said on weei via boston com we ve got another week another chance in this league and that s dealing with the ups and downs in this league that s part of it playing the national football league belichick who left the patriots the year before maye was drafted famously repeated the phrase we re on to cincinnati back in 2014 after an awful early season 41 14 loss to the kansas city chiefs the phrase became a rallying cry as the pats won their next eight games en route to a super bowl championship maye struggled mightily down the stretch of last wednesday s season opener tossing three woeful fourth quarter interceptions including the loss sealing int the third year qb completed 23 of 33 pass attempts for 178 yards one touchdown and a career high three interceptions in week 1 maye was efficient on throws under 10 air yards completing 20 of his 23 such attempts for 134 yards and a td 8 9 cpoe but struggled downfield 10 air yards connecting on just three of eight attempts for 44 yards and three ints 12 7 cpoe per next gen stats despite the dismal outing maye believes the pats offense can turn it around swiftly i think there were plays out there to be made maye said i think we had plays in the run game plays in the passing game where we had opportunities to make big plays and in this league we feel last week the way we approached it was a good plan we were ahead on the score and then in the fourth quarter still had a chance to win the game and send it to overtime at the worst i ve got to be better and i will be better going forward maye aims to improve in week 2 against a steelers defense that feasted on backup falcons qb cooper rush last sunday t j watt was a menace recording his 10th career interception on a fourth quarter pick six the pats offensive line did a better job in week 1 than in the super bowl but if the club is to get off the mat following last week s loss they ll have to protect maye from the steelers formidable pass rush

news_mentions.headline: Eagles guard Landon Dickerson: I was 'complete liability' in Week 1 win over Commanders
news_mentions.description: Eagles guard Landon Dickerson, reportedly headed to injured reserve, said on Monday that he was "a complete liability" in the team's Week 1 win.
news_mentions.body_text: the philadelphia eagles offensive line played poorly in week 1 s win over the washington commanders three time pro bowl left guard landon dickerson who has been placed on injured reserve took ownership for his part of the struggles during an appearance on wip s players lounge show on monday i was a complete liability yesterday again that was my fault dickerson said i know i said earlier in camp i shouldn t be out there until i feel healthy a few weeks ago got rolled up on in practice i thought as weeks went by it would get better it didn t and we kind of went out there and finally got some imaging on it today figured out what was wrong with it dickerson has dealt with injuries the past several seasons including a meniscus repair in august 2025 he played 15 games last season but was clearly not himself the guard has admitted he shouldn t have returned as early as he did now he s hoping to avoid a similar issue the philadelphia inquirer and espn reported that dickerson is expected to land on ir the 27 year old described the injury as a bone bruise in his right knee dickerson didn t officially confirm the move to ir but he noted he d assume the reporting is correct really the best plan going forward is to put me on ir so i can get this thing better to have a good stretch at the back end of the season versus kind of what happened last year go out there limping through 18 weeks he said i don t think anybody wants to see that again because that was just ugly i don t want to do that again because that was just some bs drew kendall a 2025 fifth round pick could fill in for dickerson after a solid training camp willie lampkin is another interior option

news_mentions.headline: Kenneth Walker III pummels Broncos in debut with Chiefs
news_mentions.description: Newly added running back Kenneth Walker III rushed for 173 yards, including a 60-yard TD dash, in his first game in Kansas City.
news_mentions.body_text: kenneth walker s first game in kansas city went as advertised the running back signed in the offseason to revamp a sluggish ground game galloped through the denver broncos defense to the tune of 173 rushing yards including a 60 yard td blast and added 18 yards on three catches with another score in monday night s 31 10 chiefs win walker s physicality ability to break tackles and home run capacity were game changers for an offense that previously leaned too heavily on patrick mahomes making magic i told you all literally like first press conference y all were asking what s the difference with our offense and i said k9 like it s just that simple mahomes said after the win via the team s official transcript it s the way he s able to run the ball catch the ball i threw a little hot to him there on that read that was probably going to be a big play but it s just a special ability to run the ball tough between the tackles and then when he does bounce it he has the speed to go all the way and so we ll utilize him walker set career highs with his 173 rushing yards and 191 scrimmage yards after sharing the backfield with zach charbonnet in seattle walker fit seamlessly in k c as the top dog you know you ve got to be making yards and for him to play the way that he did i thought it was spectacular said coach andy reid it was something you hope for and you got to see it where he was the main guy there and he did a great job with it i ll also say that our rb emmett johnson did a nice job too when he had an opportunity to get in there both those guys are contact balances ridiculous and so they got a lot of yards after contact and that s a special thing to have there walker picked up where he left off last season winning the super bowl mvp with the seattle seahawks his 191 scrimmage yards were the most by a reigning super bowl mvp in week 1 surpassing the previous record of 180 set by hall of famer jerry rice in 1989 per nfl research his career high 173 rushing yards in week 1 are the second highest by any veteran in their debut with a new team behind michael turner s 220 yard performance in his 2008 debut with the falcons perhaps most notable walker s 173 rushing yards were also the most by any player in a game started by mahomes the chiefs have employed an afterthought rushing attack for most of mahomes reign they have never had a 1 000 yard rusher since the qb took over as the starter and the last several seasons have been highly inefficient walker s arrival changed that instantly walker s ability to create splash plays completely changes the k c offense he generated 101 rushing yards over expected per nfl pro and forced a whopping 14 missed tackles the rb showed all of his attributes including game breaking speed on a 60 yard touchdown we ran the play a few times walker said of his 60 yard score i knew they were going to crash in so when they crashed in i just bounced it out i was one on one with the corner i outran him and it was off to the races from there the 60 yard scamper was the chiefs longest run since 2019 when damien williams had td runs of 91 and 84 yards over the past two seasons the longest run by any k c player was 35 yards wr xavier worthy the chiefs force fed walker the ball 26 times including 23 carries reinforcing their belief that he s a three down player it means a lot walker said of the workload it means they trust me it s good to feel that way starting undrafted rookie kahlil benson at left tackle the chiefs knew pounding the rock would be the most prudent way to protect the young blocker that it fit perfectly with the revamped plan this offseason was a bonus the offensive line took it as a challenge to go up against this defense and set the tone and they did that mahomes said and so even though the pass game didn t click the way we wanted it to click early especially it set the tone for the entire game of how we were going to move the ball down the field

news_mentions.headline: NFL ties Week 1 scoring record for Super Bowl era
news_mentions.description: Thanks to the Kansas City Chiefs and Denver Broncos reaching 41 combined points on Monday night, the opening slate of games for the 2026 season tied a record for the most Week 1 points scored during the Super Bowl era.
news_mentions.body_text: a 14 year week 1 record has been matched thanks to the kansas city chiefs and denver broncos combining for 41 points on monday night the opening slate of games for the 2026 season has officially tied the 2012 season s record for the most week 1 points scored 791 during the super bowl era entering monday s afc west showdown teams had averaged 50 0 combined points per game per nfl research with the week 1 finale bringing the average down to 49 4 tying such a mark would ve been hard to see coming on wednesday when the seattle seahawks and new england patriots kicked off the campaign with a 13 10 defensive battle in a super bowl lx rematch much of the rest of the weekend however took a different path offensive explosions proved the norm caleb williams and the chicago bears dropped 59 points on the carolina panthers the franchise s most since the 1980 season and it s not as if carolina s offense was hapless attempting to keep up the panthers put 37 on the board contributing to the highest scoring week 1 game 96 combined points in league history lamar jackson s baltimore ravens scored 41 against the indianapolis colts while josh allen s buffalo bills required a similar output to defeat the houston texans 36 31 a somewhat shocking result considering demeco ryans club hasn t allowed that many points since his first year leading houston in 2023 the jacksonville jaguars opened a large enough lead that trevor lawrence sat out the fourth quarter of a 34 10 win over the cleveland browns and the minnesota vikings who defeated the green bay packers 39 22 at one point scored 22 points in 2 46 of game time during the fourth quarter the nfl s scoring frenzy stands in stark contrast to the commonly held belief that defenses typically begin the season ahead of offenses it was not so this week leading to record tying results

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs' Travis Kelce moves into second place for all-time tight end receiving yards
news_mentions.description: Travis Kelce moved into second place all-time for receiving yards by a tight end during the Chiefs’ season opener Monday night against the Broncos.
news_mentions.body_text: it was quite a milestone offseason for travis kelce the kansas city chiefs tight end wasted no time in making it a milestone regular season as well kelce moved into second all time for receiving yards by a tight end during the chiefs 31 10 season opening monday night win over the denver broncos predictably kelce downplayed the individual milestone when speaking to espn s laura rutledge after the game it s a good feeling to get this win all the other stuff is just hoopla now he said kelce caught a 59 yard pass from old friend patrick mahomes in the third quarter to put him past longtime dallas cowboys stalwart jason witten for second all time ahead of monday s season opener kelce had 13 002 yards needing 45 to surpass witten 13 046 the catch was a turn back the clock moment for kelce standing as his longest reception since week 15 2021 when he turned in a 69 yarder versus the los angeles chargers it was a memorable way to begin kelce s 14th and perhaps final season the three time super bowl winner now trails only hall of famer tony gonzalez 15 127 in receiving yards by a tight end though the 36 year old s career is winding down his star status is not thanks in large part to his recent nuptials to pop megastar taylor swift a no doubt future hall of famer kelce an 11 time pro bowler and four time all pro ranks fifth among tight ends with 82 touchdowns and third in receptions 1 083 among his other notable accomplishments kelce has the most 100 yard games by a tight end 38 and his 1 416 yards in 2020 remaining a single season best at the position kelce s earned another tip of the helmet for what s been an astounding career but this season is just beginning as he aims to help his chiefs return to prior heavyweight status

news_mentions.headline: Seahawks: Sam Darnold has 'very unique' soft-tissue injury, no firm timeline for return
news_mentions.description: Seattle Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold is dealing with a "very unique soft-tissue injury" to his glute and his hip joint is unaffected, the team announced Monday.
news_mentions.body_text: seattle seahawks quarterback sam darnold is dealing with a very unique soft tissue injury to his glute and his hip joint is unaffected the team announced monday darnold s injury is not considered to be a long term injury but there is no firm timeline on his return to the field darnold who led the seahawks to a super bowl title in his first season with the team exited wednesday s kickoff game win over the patriots with what was initially labeled a hip injury the seahawks returned to practice on monday and darnold was not seen on the field during the portion available to the media per espn seahawks head coach mike macdonald is next scheduled to speak to reporters on wednesday monday s update comes after nfl network insider ian rapoport reported thursday that darnold avoided a major injury and could miss a few weeks macdonald said during a radio interview that same day that the team received really really good news on darnold and later added that he hoped they would have a really accurate picture of a plan of attack by monday veteran drew lock would be in line to start seattle s week 2 game against the cardinals if darnold is unable to play lock went 16 of 22 for 187 yards with one touchdown in relief of darnold against new england

news_mentions.headline: Browns sticking with Deshaun Watson as starting QB for Week 2 game vs. Buccaneers
news_mentions.description: Despite a dismal season-opening performance, Browns coach Todd Monken is sticking with Deshaun Watson as his starting quarterback for Week 2 against the Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: despite a dismal season opening performance cleveland browns coach todd monken is sticking with deshaun watson as his starting quarterback for week 2 against the tampa bay buccaneers i anticipate deshaun will be our starter monken said monday watson finished 16 of 22 passing for 205 yards with a first drive interception and a final drive 46 yard touchdown pass in a depressing 34 10 road loss to the jacksonville jaguars the first year head coach noted that it d been 693 days since watson last started after he missed most of 2024 and all of 2025 due to multiple achilles injuries oh for sure and it s only been two weeks he s gotten all the reps monken said there were some really good things on film some things that you can build on and there were some others that operationally we ve got to get better at there s concepts that there s only so many looks you get from week to week be it red zone concepts third down concepts and i did think that when he had time when he understood the concepts he didn t play tentative that he lit it rip even the touchdown at the end sure that was garbage time but that was on their no 1 corner that was one of their starters out there that was a communication between him and the receiver so there was a lot of things to build on it wasn t perfect of course not otherwise we wouldn t have scored as few points as we did but i d like to see how we can build on that i liked his week of practice last week and i think he s only going to continue to get better monken can sugarcoat sunday s rotten performance from his club any way he d like the reality is no one played well in the blowout loss starting with the quarterback perhaps the long time off played a role but even before the litany of injuries watson was one of the worst quarterbacks in the nfl nothing changed sunday the 31 year old threw a rookie level int on the opening drive conducted an offense that couldn t get in and out of the huddle cleanly had far too many mental miscues struggled with pressure and barely threatened the jags d in the first half watson threw for a measly 75 yards with an int as the browns trailed 24 0 the entire second half was basically garbage time monken said the film validated watson getting another shot under center and highlighted that the entire team must play better it confirmed it when i looked at the tape he said we ve got to play better around him we ve got to call it better and he s got to play better our inability to function consistently as an offense was a byproduct of we coaching and playing the reality for the browns new coach is that barring some miraculous turnaround in tampa cleveland fans won t be a welcoming hoard for watson in week 3 he s destined to hear louder boos than those that got under his skin in the preseason from the moment watson was named the starter it felt like an untenable situation sunday s performance did nothing to change that perception monken seems to be hoping a trip to tampa can

news_mentions.headline: Rams' Sean McVay: No timeline on Myles Garrett's return post knee surgery
news_mentions.description: News broke Sunday that Myles Garrett would undergo knee surgery and land on injured reserve, which will knock him out a minimum of four weeks. He could be out longer depending on how the knee responds.
news_mentions.body_text: the los angeles rams won t set a timeline for myles garrett s return following monday s knee surgery i don t really have a timeline yet head coach sean mcvay told reporters on monday it s all contingent upon how do things go today you feel good about it but i think it d be unfair to him or really just without having the totality of all the information to put any sort of timeline on it we know that he ll be available in four weeks potentially so we ll just take that a day at a time news broke sunday that garrett will undergo knee surgery and land on injured reserve which will knock him out a minimum of four weeks he could be out longer depending on how the knee responds garrett played in last week s season opener in australia generating five pressures but failing to record a sack or a tackle the pass rusher admitted after the game that he wasn t himself and was concerned about his knee which had limited him during training camp mcvay said he knew immediately following the game that garrett would have to go on ir it was right after the game mcvay said honestly after i talked with him after the game after i d spoken with you guys and just seeing just how he felt you look at it we thought it was something that we d be able to kinda manage that wasn t necessarily the case so having that evidence and being able to say what s the next right thing it was right after the game just in terms of listening to how he felt how he was able to impact the game and even just like what you guys saw with how limited we had to be with him obviously we thought we were doing the right thing but in hindsight you ll always be able to learn from it the decision to play garrett who came over in a ballyhooed trade with the cleveland browns despite nursing the knee injury throughout training camp sat juxtaposed to that of aaron donald who didn t play week 1 after returning from a two year absence mcvay noted that the two situations were completely different the direction that we went with myles and the direction we went with aaron are two totally separate situations and circumstances he said with myles it was more along the lines of we had been aware of this thought it was something that he d be able to work through obviously being out there and playing in a real game you learn like hey maybe that s not the case so let s change course with that with aaron it was more just getting him up to speed mcvay said the club isn t sure if donald will play week 2 in prime time versus the 1 0 new york giants on sept 21 we haven t decided that yet mcvay said of donald he s gonna continue to work his process and we ll see what it looks like if donald isn t able to play a once vaunted looking defensive front on paper will be rather thin on the field

news_mentions.headline: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane to miss several weeks with fractured wrist
news_mentions.description: Baltimore Ravens receiver Ja'Kobi Lane suffered a fractured wrist in Sunday's win over the Colts and will miss several weeks.
news_mentions.body_text: ja 39 kobi lane s promising start with the baltimore ravens has hit a speed bump out of the gate lane suffered a fractured wrist in the ravens 41 23 win over the indianapolis colts and is expected to miss several weeks nfl network insiders mike garafolo and ian rapoport reported sunday night lane will undergo future testing to determine the full extent of the ailment it s a tough blow for lane and the ravens who also lost top wideout zay flowers to a hamstring injury in the victory rapoport reported monday morning that flowers injury isn t considered serious lane s first nfl game saw him register one catch on three targets for 11 yards the ravens swooped on lane in the third round of the 2026 nfl draft and the usc product quickly grew buzz during the offseason and training camp work now he ll have to rebound from an injury and so too will the ravens devontez walker was inactive with a groin injury sunday and now with lane out for multiple weeks baltimore will need bigger contributions from lajohntay wester and chris moore from an already thin wr room the ravens 1 0 host the new orleans saints 0 1 on week 2 sunday

news_mentions.headline: Vikings QB Kyler Murray suffers concussion in first quarter of win over Packers
news_mentions.description: Minnesota Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray suffered a concussion in Sunday's  39-22 win over the Green Bay Packers and did not return.
news_mentions.body_text: minnesota vikings quarterback kyler murray suffered a concussion in sunday s 39 22 win over the green bay packers and did not return on a third and 7 scramble in the first quarter murray slid but took a big hit from packers defenders lukas van ness and javon bullard murray s helmet came off on the play and the veteran qb remained on the turf at u s bank stadium before eventually walking off under his own power and exiting to the locker room i have no update on how those evaluations have gone head coach kevin o connell said after the game we ll take it day by day and see how he comes in tomorrow o connell added that murray seemed to be doing well after the game but i wouldn t medically quote me on that bullard was flagged for unnecessary roughness on the play to prolong the vikings drive murray was just 11 plays into his debut with the vikings before exiting and went 3 of 5 for 18 yards with an interception carson wentz took over under center for minnesota going 12 of 19 for 133 yards with three touchdowns to lead the vikings to a comeback win

news_mentions.headline: Ravens RB Derrick Henry passes Marcus Allen for third on all-time rushing TD list
news_mentions.description: Baltimore Ravens RB Derrick Henry rushed for two touchdowns during the first half of Sunday's win over the Indianapolis Colts to move into third all-time on the league's rushing TD list.
news_mentions.body_text: another season another year derrick henry appears set to defy father time the baltimore ravens running back rushed for two touchdowns during the first half of sunday s season opening 41 23 win over the indianapolis colts to move into third all time on the league s rushing td list he later added a third touchdown to cement another career day in his likely hall of fame career henry now has 125 career scores on the ground two ahead of hall of famer marcus allen 123 love marcus allen henry said after the game he s a great dude and for my name to be mentioned over his is an honor i m very grateful his record breaking score came in vintage henry fashion as he rumbled through the colts defense for an explosive 32 yard td to contribute to a 31 point first half for first year coach jesse minter henry finished with 144 yards on 24 carries as baltimore moved to 1 0

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.body_text: with nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the seattle seahawks offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location virginia mason athletic center renton wash fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs las vegas raiders 10 p m et on thursday aug 7 nfl network week 2 vs kansas city chiefs 10 p m et on friday aug 15 nfl network week 3 at green bay packers 4 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note seattle begins its season with three of four games against teams that didn t make the 2024 postseason and ends it with four of five versus non playoff squads nfl research what you need to know 1 under center for a new look seahawks offense sam darnold will command a whole lot of attention throughout training camp after three seasons as the seattle starter with a pair of pro bowl campaigns included geno smith was traded to the las vegas raiders in lieu of the seahawks extending him enter darnold who inked a three year 100 5 million deal however darnold has no guaranteed salary after this season and the team can save 27 5 million with a post june 1 2026 cut so with darnold coming off an excellent overall 2024 with the minnesota vikings and two disastrous games to end his campaign the spotlight of scrutiny will be bright even in cloudy washington skies seattle also brought back veteran no 2 drew lock and drafted jalen milroe who possesses eye popping athleticism and the unknown potential of a rookie qb whom fans always clamor to see even in camp darnold s mistakes will be dissected so every snap is important even the ones that don t count toward a final score 2 much of the seahawks offseason was about the notable names they lost geno smith dk metcalf and tyler lockett however seattle made a couple of splashes with the veteran signings of ex dallas cowboys pro bowler demarcus lawrence and former los angeles rams triple crown winner cooper kupp established veteran talent doesn t usually need to show out in training camp but just how realistic it is to hope for career renaissances from kupp and lawrence will be glimpsed in the summer lawrence missed 13 games last season due to a foot injury while kupp s injury woes resulted in 18 games missed over the past three years combined kupp has two games against his former squad to look forward to and lawrence didn t hesitate to offer some shade to his ex club but just how much they have left is likely to be a major factor in the seahawks 2025 fortunes 3 over the 2024 regular season sam darnold threw for career highs of 4 319 yards and 35 touchdowns with the minnesota vikings he averaged 3 08 seconds to throw third longest time in the nfl as he attempted 73 2 of his passes after 2 5 seconds the highest rate in the league according to nfl pro in the vikings playoff loss to the los angeles rams darnold was sacked nine times resulting in his lowest total epa generated last year 27 4 translation for darnold to work within the seahawks offense he needs to be protected well left tackle charles cross is a stalwart and how 2025 first rounder grey zabel comes along at left guard will be crucial at right tackle the biggest question for abraham lucas is staying healthy he s played in just 13 of a potential 34 games over the past two seasons perhaps the largest quandary and camp battle will come at center and right guard olu oluwatimi and jalen sundell will likely duke it out for the starting center spot while christian haynes anthony bradford and possibly sixth rounder bryce cabeldue will decide the right guard slot giving darnold time to work is paramount working out who will be tasked with doing that will be decided in camp

news_mentions.headline: Minnesota Vikings training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Minnesota Vikings' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the minnesota vikings offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 20 rookies july 22 veterans location tco performance center eagan minnesota fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs houston texans saturday aug 9 at 4 p m et nfl network week 2 vs new england patriots saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 at tennessee titans friday aug 22 at 8 p m et cbs 2025 schedule note the vikings will be the first team in nfl history to play a game in multiple international countries in the same season week 4 in ireland and week 5 in england nfl research what you need to know 1 it s all about j j mccarthy in minnesota the second year quarterback will be under the microscope as he takes over an offense that rejuvenated sam darnold s career last season the vikings decided not to buffer mccarthy with a veteran backup after daniel jones opted to sign with indianapolis apologies to the sam howell stans but he s not a threat to mccarthy the former first round pick inherited the porsche of offenses which has made almost every driver look good kevin o connell is a proven qb whisperer so the assumption is that mccarthy should have little trouble keeping things afloat with justin jefferson jordan addison t j hockenson and a remade offensive line the vikes offer weapons to aid the young signal caller minnesota is a 14 win club that on paper improved entering 2025 the loudest question is mccarthy and whether he can keep the engine humming after missing all of 2024 it s not hyperbole to suggest that mccarthy is the pendulum that could swing the course of the entire nfc north 2 the top camp battle in minnesota comes in the secondary heretofore the vikings have yet to add a veteran to the mix who could push for a starting gig next to byron murphy it feels as though the club could be waiting to see how mekhi blackmon bounces back after missing the entire 2024 season due to an acl tear isaiah rodgers blackmon and jeff okudah are in line to battle for the cb2 role elsewhere in the vikings secondary the club didn t replace no 3 safety camryn bynum who left for indianapolis this offseason defensive coordinator brian flores used three safeties liberally last season if he does so again would he trust the likes of theo jackson in that role could a veteran be added closer to the season 3 will the interior offensive line upgrades pay off the internal pressure proved to be sam darnold s undoing last year general manager kwesi adofo mensah set out to fix the issue signing veterans ryan kelly and will fries from indy then he drafted guard donovan jackson in the first round in theory the moves should solidify a leaky interior however kelly and fries are both coming off injury plagued seasons those concerns are coupled with star left tackle christian darrisaw coming off a season ending knee injury the offseason overhaul is excellent from a starter s perspective but there are questions among the second string crew should injuries strike again

material_news_signals.headline: Seahawks rule out Sam Darnold for Week 2, don't plan to put QB on IR; Drew Lock to start vs. Cards
material_news_signals.description: Sam Darnold won't take the field in Week 2, but the outlook is promising. Darnold (glute) is not expected to land on injured reserve, Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald told reporters Wednesday.
material_news_signals.body_text: sam darnold won t take the field in week 2 but the outlook is promising darnold glute is not expected to land on injured reserve seahawks coach mike macdonald told reporters wednesday i don t anticipate putting him on ir or anything like that macdonald said but we ll just kind of re evaluate every day and re evaluate next week and we ll go from there but he won t play this week drew lock will start in place of darnold on sunday in arizona and jalen milroe will serve as the backup per macdonald darnold suffered what the seahawks called a very unique soft tissue injury to his glute just five snaps into seattle s season opening win over new england when he was sacked on third down limping off the field in obvious discomfort he did not return forcing lock into the game for what was eventually a comeback victory to start the campaign initially there were legitimate fears darnold had injured his hip but seattle clarified the qb s hip joint was not affected while adding there wasn t yet a firm timeline on darnold s return wednesday s update suggests darnold will be back within a month and allows the seahawks to take a week by week approach in the meantime lock will fill the starting job and aim to build on the strong finish he and the seahawks offense produced in week 1

material_news_signals.headline: Seahawks: Sam Darnold has 'very unique' soft-tissue injury, no firm timeline for return
material_news_signals.description: Seattle Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold is dealing with a "very unique soft-tissue injury" to his glute and his hip joint is unaffected, the team announced Monday.
material_news_signals.body_text: seattle seahawks quarterback sam darnold is dealing with a very unique soft tissue injury to his glute and his hip joint is unaffected the team announced monday darnold s injury is not considered to be a long term injury but there is no firm timeline on his return to the field darnold who led the seahawks to a super bowl title in his first season with the team exited wednesday s kickoff game win over the patriots with what was initially labeled a hip injury the seahawks returned to practice on monday and darnold was not seen on the field during the portion available to the media per espn seahawks head coach mike macdonald is next scheduled to speak to reporters on wednesday monday s update comes after nfl network insider ian rapoport reported thursday that darnold avoided a major injury and could miss a few weeks macdonald said during a radio interview that same day that the team received really really good news on darnold and later added that he hoped they would have a really accurate picture of a plan of attack by monday veteran drew lock would be in line to start seattle s week 2 game against the cardinals if darnold is unable to play lock went 16 of 22 for 187 yards with one touchdown in relief of darnold against new england

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 2: Caleb Williams, Lamar Jackson and Trevor Lawrence soar into top five
news_mentions.description: Movement abounds in Nick Shook's QB Index, with prolific passers like Trevor Lawrence flying up the rankings as scattershot signal-callers like Drake Maye plummet. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: i begin this qb index with a disclaimer with only one week s worth of evidence there is more volatility than usual reputation matters but so do recent results we re a long way from solidifying the standing of many of these quarterbacks and because we saw some unexpected outcomes in week 1 prepare yourself for some aggressive swings it ll even out eventually for now i have one bit of advice buckle up note up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 1 qb index tier 1 josh allen nearly blew buffalo s chances of scoring a huge week 1 win with an inexplicable yolo ball into the end zone late in the fourth quarter but houston cb kamari lassiter dropped the potential game sealing pick now that i ve put that on the record allow me to acknowledge that allen was otherwise marvelous in this contest he played all the allen hits in the bills 36 31 win he scored a rushing touchdown on a wild scramble connected with dj moore on a 43 yard touchdown pass scored another rushing touchdown from a yard out and directed a 96 yard touchdown drive with the game on the line capping it by firing a rocket between two defenders to josh palmer for the game winning score that s a great start to his annual mvp push next gen stats insight via nfl pro allen averaged 12 6 air yards per attempt his highest mark in a game since week 18 of 2022 and he was efficient pushing the ball downfield completing 11 of 16 attempts of 10 plus air yards for 286 yards and two touchdowns caleb williams remains one of the most thrilling joyous watches in the nfl he makes throws nobody else is capable of completing on a weekly basis and did so at least twice on sunday dropping a laser guided strike over two defenders to cole kmet for a touchdown and heaving an off platform missile to rome odunze to set up another score in the first game of williams third professional season i arrived at a new realization the 24 year old now deeply understands the timing and priorities of ben johnson s scheme and operates comfortably within its structure but much like a great guitarist caleb s artistic improvisation is what makes him special and elevates chicago s offense from very good to fantastic sunday s game included a collection of such examples producing thrills on the ground and through the air that have become part of williams brand next gen stats insight via nfl pro williams reached a top speed of 20 8 mph on his second touchdown run a 29 yard scamper in the final minute of the second quarter of chicago s 59 37 win over carolina lamar jackson raved about declan doyle s offense as a breath of fresh air entering the new season perhaps he should have described it as a hurricane because baltimore destroyed indianapolis on sunday jackson played an integral part throwing for 324 yards by leaning heavily on zay flowers early and distributing the ball fairly evenly after the star wideout left with a hamstring tweak it helped that everything worked for the offense but i won t let derrick henry s 144 yards take away from jackson s performance if this becomes the standard for the ravens expect jackson to own a firm place in the mvp discussion again things looked too easy for trevor lawrence and the jaguars who shredded cleveland s defense all afternoon in jacksonville parker washington jakobi meyers and even brenton strange all renewed their connection with lawrence who picked up right where he left off at the end of the 2025 season tier 2 this ranking isn t entirely based on one week s showing and this is where reputation mixes with results matthew stafford wasn t himself in the rams season opening loss to the 49ers in australia but the reigning nfl mvp wasn t all that awful surprisingly stafford finished with a completion percentage over expected cpoe of 2 5 bryce young played excellently on the other hand and leapfrogs stafford for perhaps the only time all season in fact let s take a second to dive a little deeper into young s performance a typically up and down quarterback young looked confident in his most aggressive game since he threw for 448 yards in carolina s week 11 win over atlanta last season most importantly young finally looked fully comfortable in dave canales offense made decisions with conviction and truly elevated carolina s offense was it enough to keep up with caleb williams bears no but it s worth tracking over the next month because it could heavily influence his contract talks with the panthers if this is a preview of what s to come next gen stats insight via nfl pro young threw for 289 yards and averaged 14 5 yards per attempt against zone coverage compared to 72 yards and 4 2 yards per attempt against man coverage in sunday s loss to chicago now back to the rest of the group patrick mahomes scored a rushing touchdown but it s clear he s not quite back to his old self in the mobility department which didn t help his passing efforts early in monday night s 31 10 win over denver that s fine when kenneth walker is shredding an opposing defense but kansas city can t count on that every week mahomes eventually found a rhythm in the second half and finished the game with a pair of td passes but i didn t expect him to start lighting up defenses through the air instantly this will probably be a slow burn dak prescott joe burrow and jared goff largely looked like themselves but at lower than usual outputs with prescott adding an uncharacteristic interception as a result of a failed throwaway attempt that led to a giants touchdown every quarterback is shaking off some rust in week 1 so there s no cause for alarm brock purdy was incredibly sharp in australia and confidently cooked the rams defense even after losing de zhaun stribling to injury the uncs of the world enjoyed watching him connect with three different thirtysomething receivers for touchdowns and i m sure purdy was happy to have mike evans on his side to start the season next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy tied his career high with seven straight dropbacks when aligned under center no play action in week 1 against the rams completing all seven passes for 76 yards and two touchdowns including a 39 yard strike to demarcus robinson in the second quarter jalen hurts had a classic jalen hurts game in week 1 connecting on a handful of downfield shots while willing philadelphia s offense down the field with well timed scrambles against washington the eagles still need to be more consistent offensively on a per play basis but for one week hurts was able to carry them out of the muck to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 6 of 9 downfield passes 10 air yards for 176 yards and three touchdowns in week 1 against the commanders his yardage on those throws was the eighth highest downfield total of his career while he threw three plus downfield touchdown passes for just the sixth time tier 3 remember how i said there would be some stunning volatility in the rankings this week well we ve reached that portion of the program i couldn t stomach dropping justin herbert any further because he still threw for 200 yards but that interception in the fourth quarter was ghastly and an unnecessary risk which we usually don t see from herbert especially when trying to climb out of a nine point hole tyler shough on the other hand shook off his early mistakes and let it rip in the second half throwing the saints back into a game that seemed destined to end in a lopsided loss i m not afraid to admit how much i m enjoying watching him progress as a starter he s fearless when the pressure is on and is developing a clutch gene that should entertain saints fans throughout 2026 it would be nice if their offense woke up earlier next time though next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 8 of 11 passes against the lions blitz for 79 yards and three touchdowns in the second half and overtime after going just 2 of 7 for 17 yards with an interception and a sack fumble in the first half on downfield passes 10 air yards shough completed 11 of 16 attempts for 261 yards and a touchdown the most such yards by a saints quarterback since drew brees in week 6 2016 c j stroud played really well for most of sunday s close loss to the bills but bookending a good game with lost fumbles will knock you down the qb index jordan love lands in the same category after singlehandedly carrying the packers offense through three quarters then crumbling beneath the pressure applied by brian flores defense it wasn t his fault alone green bay s offensive line struggled significantly with picking up blitzes and stunts but as the director of the offense love needed to be better to stop the meltdown we only saw a handful of plays from sam darnold glute injury who lands ahead of jacoby brissett largely because he wasn t afforded much time to succeed or fail brissett certainly didn t fail powering a hungry cardinals offense by leaning on trey mcbride and even finding marvin harrison for a long completion on arizona s way to stunning the chargers next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett completed 6 of 9 passes for 113 yards 23 9 cpoe on throws over 10 air yards in the cards upset win over the bolts drake maye s decent start completely fell apart in the fourth quarter and two of his three interceptions were solely his fault in terms of starts following an mvp runner up campaign this one will not be remembered fondly next gen stats insight via nfl pro all three of maye s interceptions came on deep attempts 20 plus air yards two more than he threw all last season one maye s interception on new england s final drive lost the patriots 47 9 win probability the most on a single pass attempt of his career geno smith did a lot to prove the raiders nightmarish situation was to blame for his ugly 2025 season benefitting from a strong offensive line in a very professional week 1 outing and kindling a new connection with adonai mitchell that deserves the eyes emoji jaxson dart delivered a similar performance and introduced the world to his new favorite target former ravens tight end and new new york star isaiah likely i m fascinated to see if the giants can sustain this level of success against better defenses than the cowboys revamped unit tier 4 when you sign up for a season with baker mayfield you know you ll have days in which his competitive streak and refusal to surrender will lead to multiple turnovers it happened twice on sunday with the first resulting in a defensive touchdown for the bengals and the second probably costing the buccaneers seven points baker giveth and taketh away but it s probably best it happened in week 1 not week 18 next gen stats insight via nfl pro mayfield averaged 4 7 air yards per attempt fourth fewest in a game in his career and 2 0 air yards per completion third fewest in the 33 27 loss to the bengals he completed 18 of 19 passes under 10 air yards for 134 yards and 5 of 8 passes over 10 air yards for 82 yards jayden daniels produced a mixed bag in philadelphia but the third year pro moved around confidently and delivered in key spots keeping washington in a tight contest that included a nice touchdown pass to stefon diggs and saw daniels lead the commanders on a 12 play 63 yard touchdown drive in crunch time most importantly he exited a pressure packed afternoon healthy next gen stats insight via nfl pro daniels was pressured on 19 of 38 dropbacks in week 1 against the eagles translating to a 50 0 pressure rate that tied his career high week 9 of 2025 vs seattle he went 15 for 19 with 138 yards and a touchdown when throwing from a clean pocket 78 9 completion percentage but just 3 for 15 with 26 yards and a touchdown when under pressure 20 0 aaron rodgers delivered one vintage moment when he rolled left set his feet and fired a bullet to pat freiermuth in the back of the end zone otherwise much of sunday saw rodgers try to force a connection with dk metcalf take many more deep shots than he did last season and finish with a passable at best performance at least he looked more like himself in mike mccarthy s offense next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers 9 2 air yards per target in sunday s 20 13 win over the falcons is the highest figure he has recorded as a member of the steelers with his 2 95 second time to throw mark representing his third highest average in a game with the franchise bo nix produced one truly impressive scoring drive and capped it with a pretty touchdown pass to evan engram to tie monday night s game at 7 7 that was it for the highlights the rest of the night included plenty of lowlights with nix appearing overwhelmed and out of sync amid a hailstorm of pressures generated by steve spagnuolo s defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix was pressured on 45 5 of his dropbacks against the chiefs his second highest pressure rate in a game in his career nix finished 2 of 10 for 5 yards and an interception under pressure with two strip sacks compared to 15 of 18 for 126 yards and a touchdown from a clean pocket kirk cousins played fine football against the lowly dolphins took what miami s defense gave him kept drives moving and finished three with touchdown tosses which meets the standard of expectation for him it also helped that raiders rb ashton jeanty became the dolphins most important problem cousins age showed in his performance though with the 38 year old throwing a couple of ugly interceptions and one dirt ball that saddened me because of how the man fell without getting touched as he threw it i think the wait for no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza won t last all that long daniel jones didn t move as much as usual in his first game back from a season ending achilles injury but it was difficult to put too much stock in his performance given how quickly the ravens buried the colts in a three score deficit he showed some rust in his decision making too forcing a pass into a window that didn t exist with roquan smith lurking underneath in coverage resulting in an interception malik willis did some nice things but was up and down at best and is clearly still acclimating to life as a full time starter his mobility is a weapon and helped him score a rushing touchdown he threw a handful of pretty passes and never looked especially overwhelmed he also threw a groaner of an interception and wasn t able to elevate the dolphins offense as they ll need him to in order to compete this season as far as debuts go it was passable given the surrounding circumstances but there s plenty of room to improve tier 5 kyler murray s debut in minnesota didn t last long included an interception on his first pass attempt a desperation heave fired under instant pressure and ended when he slid at the end of a short scramble was hit late drawing a flag and suffered a concussion leaving me with almost nothing to evaluate in the few snaps he saw prior to exiting there wasn t much to like cam ward s first game in brian daboll s offense was not the dream many fans hoped for the absence of a running game and ineffective pass protection limited ward who didn t handle the challenges well this process will take some time and will definitely include growing pains there were plenty in sunday s 23 10 loss to the jets next gen stats insight via nfl pro ward faced pressure on 42 1 of dropbacks the second highest rate of his career 50 in week 1 of 2025 vs denver under pressure ward completed 3 of 10 passes for 17 yards compared to 16 of 22 for 123 yards and a touchdown without pressure cooper rush was only effective on passes behind the line of scrimmage eliminating the downfield threat from atlanta s offense one target zero catches for kyle pitts and funneling the entire falcons attack through bijan robinson that understandably only worked early and once the steelers adjusted rush had nowhere else to turn succumbing to the pressure applied by pittsburgh s defense in an ugly low scoring loss he also didn t face a single man coverage snap somewhat of a slap in the face from the steelers defense which didn t fear rush enough to try to blanket falcons pass catchers in one on one matchups next gen stats insight via nfl pro rush did not complete a pass when pressured and particularly struggled when holding on to the ball for longer than 2 5 seconds completing 6 of 14 attempts for 83 yards while throwing two interceptions deshaun watson s numbers lied to you he looked just as slow to make decisions as he did in the preseason was consistently inaccurate especially when unsettled by the pass rush threw an awful interception on his third attempt of the season ran himself into pressures with remarkably deep pass drops and generally played like a quarterback who hadn t seen regular season action in two years todd monken told reporters he found plenty to like in watson s tape but the only example i can support was his downfield shot to rookie denzel boston for a touchdown in garbage time i think week 2 might be his last shot to prove he s still worth rostering that is unless monken stubbornly keeps rolling with him
