from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: 2025 NFL position battles: Picks to win 10 notable training camp competitions across the league
news_mentions.description: With training camps opening across the NFL, which position battles demand your attention? Kevin Patra spotlights 10 intriguing competitions, including four quarterback derbies.
news_mentions.body_text: summer is over for pigskin professionals the nfl is back with training camps opening across the league it s time for the competitions for jobs to commence competition is the name of the game for every squad it s what breeds improvement and ultimately leads to winning certain positions with limited rep sharing lend themselves to more notable battles you won t see many defensive competitions highlighted mainly because the hefty rotations and matchup centric usage tend to make camp fights less impactful as the season approaches below are the top 10 camp battles i ll be monitoring throughout training camp and into the preseason

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 2: Caleb Williams, Lamar Jackson and Trevor Lawrence soar into top five
news_mentions.description: Movement abounds in Nick Shook's QB Index, with prolific passers like Trevor Lawrence flying up the rankings as scattershot signal-callers like Drake Maye plummet. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: i begin this qb index with a disclaimer with only one week s worth of evidence there is more volatility than usual reputation matters but so do recent results we re a long way from solidifying the standing of many of these quarterbacks and because we saw some unexpected outcomes in week 1 prepare yourself for some aggressive swings it ll even out eventually for now i have one bit of advice buckle up note up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 1 qb index tier 1 josh allen nearly blew buffalo s chances of scoring a huge week 1 win with an inexplicable yolo ball into the end zone late in the fourth quarter but houston cb kamari lassiter dropped the potential game sealing pick now that i ve put that on the record allow me to acknowledge that allen was otherwise marvelous in this contest he played all the allen hits in the bills 36 31 win he scored a rushing touchdown on a wild scramble connected with dj moore on a 43 yard touchdown pass scored another rushing touchdown from a yard out and directed a 96 yard touchdown drive with the game on the line capping it by firing a rocket between two defenders to josh palmer for the game winning score that s a great start to his annual mvp push next gen stats insight via nfl pro allen averaged 12 6 air yards per attempt his highest mark in a game since week 18 of 2022 and he was efficient pushing the ball downfield completing 11 of 16 attempts of 10 plus air yards for 286 yards and two touchdowns caleb williams remains one of the most thrilling joyous watches in the nfl he makes throws nobody else is capable of completing on a weekly basis and did so at least twice on sunday dropping a laser guided strike over two defenders to cole kmet for a touchdown and heaving an off platform missile to rome odunze to set up another score in the first game of williams third professional season i arrived at a new realization the 24 year old now deeply understands the timing and priorities of ben johnson s scheme and operates comfortably within its structure but much like a great guitarist caleb s artistic improvisation is what makes him special and elevates chicago s offense from very good to fantastic sunday s game included a collection of such examples producing thrills on the ground and through the air that have become part of williams brand next gen stats insight via nfl pro williams reached a top speed of 20 8 mph on his second touchdown run a 29 yard scamper in the final minute of the second quarter of chicago s 59 37 win over carolina lamar jackson raved about declan doyle s offense as a breath of fresh air entering the new season perhaps he should have described it as a hurricane because baltimore destroyed indianapolis on sunday jackson played an integral part throwing for 324 yards by leaning heavily on zay flowers early and distributing the ball fairly evenly after the star wideout left with a hamstring tweak it helped that everything worked for the offense but i won t let derrick henry s 144 yards take away from jackson s performance if this becomes the standard for the ravens expect jackson to own a firm place in the mvp discussion again things looked too easy for trevor lawrence and the jaguars who shredded cleveland s defense all afternoon in jacksonville parker washington jakobi meyers and even brenton strange all renewed their connection with lawrence who picked up right where he left off at the end of the 2025 season tier 2 this ranking isn t entirely based on one week s showing and this is where reputation mixes with results matthew stafford wasn t himself in the rams season opening loss to the 49ers in australia but the reigning nfl mvp wasn t all that awful surprisingly stafford finished with a completion percentage over expected cpoe of 2 5 bryce young played excellently on the other hand and leapfrogs stafford for perhaps the only time all season in fact let s take a second to dive a little deeper into young s performance a typically up and down quarterback young looked confident in his most aggressive game since he threw for 448 yards in carolina s week 11 win over atlanta last season most importantly young finally looked fully comfortable in dave canales offense made decisions with conviction and truly elevated carolina s offense was it enough to keep up with caleb williams bears no but it s worth tracking over the next month because it could heavily influence his contract talks with the panthers if this is a preview of what s to come next gen stats insight via nfl pro young threw for 289 yards and averaged 14 5 yards per attempt against zone coverage compared to 72 yards and 4 2 yards per attempt against man coverage in sunday s loss to chicago now back to the rest of the group patrick mahomes scored a rushing touchdown but it s clear he s not quite back to his old self in the mobility department which didn t help his passing efforts early in monday night s 31 10 win over denver that s fine when kenneth walker is shredding an opposing defense but kansas city can t count on that every week mahomes eventually found a rhythm in the second half and finished the game with a pair of td passes but i didn t expect him to start lighting up defenses through the air instantly this will probably be a slow burn dak prescott joe burrow and jared goff largely looked like themselves but at lower than usual outputs with prescott adding an uncharacteristic interception as a result of a failed throwaway attempt that led to a giants touchdown every quarterback is shaking off some rust in week 1 so there s no cause for alarm brock purdy was incredibly sharp in australia and confidently cooked the rams defense even after losing de zhaun stribling to injury the uncs of the world enjoyed watching him connect with three different thirtysomething receivers for touchdowns and i m sure purdy was happy to have mike evans on his side to start the season next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy tied his career high with seven straight dropbacks when aligned under center no play action in week 1 against the rams completing all seven passes for 76 yards and two touchdowns including a 39 yard strike to demarcus robinson in the second quarter jalen hurts had a classic jalen hurts game in week 1 connecting on a handful of downfield shots while willing philadelphia s offense down the field with well timed scrambles against washington the eagles still need to be more consistent offensively on a per play basis but for one week hurts was able to carry them out of the muck to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 6 of 9 downfield passes 10 air yards for 176 yards and three touchdowns in week 1 against the commanders his yardage on those throws was the eighth highest downfield total of his career while he threw three plus downfield touchdown passes for just the sixth time tier 3 remember how i said there would be some stunning volatility in the rankings this week well we ve reached that portion of the program i couldn t stomach dropping justin herbert any further because he still threw for 200 yards but that interception in the fourth quarter was ghastly and an unnecessary risk which we usually don t see from herbert especially when trying to climb out of a nine point hole tyler shough on the other hand shook off his early mistakes and let it rip in the second half throwing the saints back into a game that seemed destined to end in a lopsided loss i m not afraid to admit how much i m enjoying watching him progress as a starter he s fearless when the pressure is on and is developing a clutch gene that should entertain saints fans throughout 2026 it would be nice if their offense woke up earlier next time though next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 8 of 11 passes against the lions blitz for 79 yards and three touchdowns in the second half and overtime after going just 2 of 7 for 17 yards with an interception and a sack fumble in the first half on downfield passes 10 air yards shough completed 11 of 16 attempts for 261 yards and a touchdown the most such yards by a saints quarterback since drew brees in week 6 2016 c j stroud played really well for most of sunday s close loss to the bills but bookending a good game with lost fumbles will knock you down the qb index jordan love lands in the same category after singlehandedly carrying the packers offense through three quarters then crumbling beneath the pressure applied by brian flores defense it wasn t his fault alone green bay s offensive line struggled significantly with picking up blitzes and stunts but as the director of the offense love needed to be better to stop the meltdown we only saw a handful of plays from sam darnold glute injury who lands ahead of jacoby brissett largely because he wasn t afforded much time to succeed or fail brissett certainly didn t fail powering a hungry cardinals offense by leaning on trey mcbride and even finding marvin harrison for a long completion on arizona s way to stunning the chargers next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett completed 6 of 9 passes for 113 yards 23 9 cpoe on throws over 10 air yards in the cards upset win over the bolts drake maye s decent start completely fell apart in the fourth quarter and two of his three interceptions were solely his fault in terms of starts following an mvp runner up campaign this one will not be remembered fondly next gen stats insight via nfl pro all three of maye s interceptions came on deep attempts 20 plus air yards two more than he threw all last season one maye s interception on new england s final drive lost the patriots 47 9 win probability the most on a single pass attempt of his career geno smith did a lot to prove the raiders nightmarish situation was to blame for his ugly 2025 season benefitting from a strong offensive line in a very professional week 1 outing and kindling a new connection with adonai mitchell that deserves the eyes emoji jaxson dart delivered a similar performance and introduced the world to his new favorite target former ravens tight end and new new york star isaiah likely i m fascinated to see if the giants can sustain this level of success against better defenses than the cowboys revamped unit tier 4 when you sign up for a season with baker mayfield you know you ll have days in which his competitive streak and refusal to surrender will lead to multiple turnovers it happened twice on sunday with the first resulting in a defensive touchdown for the bengals and the second probably costing the buccaneers seven points baker giveth and taketh away but it s probably best it happened in week 1 not week 18 next gen stats insight via nfl pro mayfield averaged 4 7 air yards per attempt fourth fewest in a game in his career and 2 0 air yards per completion third fewest in the 33 27 loss to the bengals he completed 18 of 19 passes under 10 air yards for 134 yards and 5 of 8 passes over 10 air yards for 82 yards jayden daniels produced a mixed bag in philadelphia but the third year pro moved around confidently and delivered in key spots keeping washington in a tight contest that included a nice touchdown pass to stefon diggs and saw daniels lead the commanders on a 12 play 63 yard touchdown drive in crunch time most importantly he exited a pressure packed afternoon healthy next gen stats insight via nfl pro daniels was pressured on 19 of 38 dropbacks in week 1 against the eagles translating to a 50 0 pressure rate that tied his career high week 9 of 2025 vs seattle he went 15 for 19 with 138 yards and a touchdown when throwing from a clean pocket 78 9 completion percentage but just 3 for 15 with 26 yards and a touchdown when under pressure 20 0 aaron rodgers delivered one vintage moment when he rolled left set his feet and fired a bullet to pat freiermuth in the back of the end zone otherwise much of sunday saw rodgers try to force a connection with dk metcalf take many more deep shots than he did last season and finish with a passable at best performance at least he looked more like himself in mike mccarthy s offense next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers 9 2 air yards per target in sunday s 20 13 win over the falcons is the highest figure he has recorded as a member of the steelers with his 2 95 second time to throw mark representing his third highest average in a game with the franchise bo nix produced one truly impressive scoring drive and capped it with a pretty touchdown pass to evan engram to tie monday night s game at 7 7 that was it for the highlights the rest of the night included plenty of lowlights with nix appearing overwhelmed and out of sync amid a hailstorm of pressures generated by steve spagnuolo s defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix was pressured on 45 5 of his dropbacks against the chiefs his second highest pressure rate in a game in his career nix finished 2 of 10 for 5 yards and an interception under pressure with two strip sacks compared to 15 of 18 for 126 yards and a touchdown from a clean pocket kirk cousins played fine football against the lowly dolphins took what miami s defense gave him kept drives moving and finished three with touchdown tosses which meets the standard of expectation for him it also helped that raiders rb ashton jeanty became the dolphins most important problem cousins age showed in his performance though with the 38 year old throwing a couple of ugly interceptions and one dirt ball that saddened me because of how the man fell without getting touched as he threw it i think the wait for no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza won t last all that long daniel jones didn t move as much as usual in his first game back from a season ending achilles injury but it was difficult to put too much stock in his performance given how quickly the ravens buried the colts in a three score deficit he showed some rust in his decision making too forcing a pass into a window that didn t exist with roquan smith lurking underneath in coverage resulting in an interception malik willis did some nice things but was up and down at best and is clearly still acclimating to life as a full time starter his mobility is a weapon and helped him score a rushing touchdown he threw a handful of pretty passes and never looked especially overwhelmed he also threw a groaner of an interception and wasn t able to elevate the dolphins offense as they ll need him to in order to compete this season as far as debuts go it was passable given the surrounding circumstances but there s plenty of room to improve tier 5 kyler murray s debut in minnesota didn t last long included an interception on his first pass attempt a desperation heave fired under instant pressure and ended when he slid at the end of a short scramble was hit late drawing a flag and suffered a concussion leaving me with almost nothing to evaluate in the few snaps he saw prior to exiting there wasn t much to like cam ward s first game in brian daboll s offense was not the dream many fans hoped for the absence of a running game and ineffective pass protection limited ward who didn t handle the challenges well this process will take some time and will definitely include growing pains there were plenty in sunday s 23 10 loss to the jets next gen stats insight via nfl pro ward faced pressure on 42 1 of dropbacks the second highest rate of his career 50 in week 1 of 2025 vs denver under pressure ward completed 3 of 10 passes for 17 yards compared to 16 of 22 for 123 yards and a touchdown without pressure cooper rush was only effective on passes behind the line of scrimmage eliminating the downfield threat from atlanta s offense one target zero catches for kyle pitts and funneling the entire falcons attack through bijan robinson that understandably only worked early and once the steelers adjusted rush had nowhere else to turn succumbing to the pressure applied by pittsburgh s defense in an ugly low scoring loss he also didn t face a single man coverage snap somewhat of a slap in the face from the steelers defense which didn t fear rush enough to try to blanket falcons pass catchers in one on one matchups next gen stats insight via nfl pro rush did not complete a pass when pressured and particularly struggled when holding on to the ball for longer than 2 5 seconds completing 6 of 14 attempts for 83 yards while throwing two interceptions deshaun watson s numbers lied to you he looked just as slow to make decisions as he did in the preseason was consistently inaccurate especially when unsettled by the pass rush threw an awful interception on his third attempt of the season ran himself into pressures with remarkably deep pass drops and generally played like a quarterback who hadn t seen regular season action in two years todd monken told reporters he found plenty to like in watson s tape but the only example i can support was his downfield shot to rookie denzel boston for a touchdown in garbage time i think week 2 might be his last shot to prove he s still worth rostering that is unless monken stubbornly keeps rolling with him

news_mentions.headline: Which are the best and worst NFL offseason additions after one week?
news_mentions.body_text: the buildup to week 1 is a marathon nfl teams start reconfiguring their rosters in march signings trades and draft picks cultivate hope and speculation which teams improved which teams did not how will these new players fit into schemes and systems which moves will tell the story of the season all fun questions to consider through the offseason months but the most fascinating part of the process is seeing all the moves come together or fail to mesh when football begins teams provided plenty of early returns on that front as they kicked off the 2026 season last week my goal this season is to monitor all the veteran offseason moves on a week to week basis to determine which signings and trades have been most impactful teams that are crowned offseason champions do not always realize those gains during the actual season some offseason moves that fly under the radar become immensely consequential it is only one week and there is a lot of football to be played still plenty of performances jumped out from week 1 both positively and negatively here are the offseason moves that are trending up and trending down after the first week of action trending up kenneth walker rb kansas city chiefs the chiefs signed walker to a free agent deal averaging 14 35 million per year this offseason andy reid 39 s offenses had lacked an explosive element in the designed running game for years the walker signing seemed to be an attempt to change that the vision came to life in the chiefs 39 31 10 win over the denver broncos on monday night walker rushed for 173 yards on 23 attempts quarterback patrick mahomes played in his first game since suffering a season ending knee injury in december walker is a game changing talent and he will clearly shoulder some of the offensive load as mahomes works his way fully back walker had four explosive rushes in the game including a 60 yard touchdown it was the chiefs 39 longest rush since 2019 last year isiah pacheco had four explosive rushes all season kareem hunt had five the chiefs offense changed decisively with walker in the backfield mahomes averaged 0 05 epa per dropback in monday 39 s win according to trumedia previously the chiefs had only won 10 games in mahomes 39 career when the quarterback averaged 0 05 epa per dropback or worse isaiah likely te new york giants the giants signed likely to a three year 40 million contract in free agency he had a standout debut for new york catching eight passes for 78 yards and two touchdowns likely was fourth among all players in epa per route run in week 1 according to trumedia he is already emerging as a security blanket for second year quarterback jaxson dart who looked comfortable and surgical in the new giants offense likely missed time last season with a fractured foot he suffered in training camp he finished 2025 with career lows in receptions yards and touchdowns the giants and new head coach john harbaugh still paid likely as a top five tight end harbaugh and likely were together with the baltimore ravens from 2022 to 39 25 likely is making good on that deal through one week tyler linderbaum c las vegas raiders the raiders signed linderbaum to a giant contract averaging 27 million in annual value this offseason he was excellent in week 1 against the miami dolphins as new coach klint kubiak got his tenure started with a win linderbaum did not allow a pressure he was a complete difference maker in the run and pass games the raiders had a positive epa per designed rush according to trumedia they did not have such a game in 2025 the raiders allowed a pressure rate of 22 6 percent on quarterback kirk cousins that was better than all but one game in 2025 linderbaum looks like he will be a force multiplier for the raiders 39 offensive line we will see how the raiders perform against more talented fronts starting in week 2 against the los angeles chargers all three of the cincinnati bengals 39 big defensive additions the bengals overhauled their defense this offseason with three splash moves they traded for defensive tackle dexter lawrence they signed edge rusher boye mafe and safety bryan cook in free agency in a week 1 win over the tampa bay buccaneers the bengals looked like a dramatically elevated unit those three additions all played huge roles cook had a forced fumble that was recovered by mafe cook recovered a baker mayfield fumble in the end zone and lawrence created the initial pressure that forced mayfield from the pocket on a fumble return touchdown in the first quarter mafe created the initial pressure on mayfield mafe also had a sack fumble on mayfield beating all pro tackle tristan wirfs the bengals will be competitive this season if they can maintain this level of disruption on defense they have the horses now on that side of the ball dylan parham g new york jets the jets won their opener over the tennessee titans and new offensive coordinator frank reich was clearly determined to establish the rushing attack in his first game calling plays the jets called designed runs on 65 6 percent of their early downs in the first 28 minutes of sunday 39 s game according to trumedia jets backs breece hall and braelon allen combined for 142 rushing yards on 32 carries parham who signed a two year 16 million deal with the jets this offseason played a big part in that performance as the starting left guard reich was taking advantage of parham 39 s athleticism by using him as a puller parham was very good as a run blocker he also held his own in pass protection against jeffery simmons one of the best interior rushers in football the jets have a solid group up front on offense and they seem determined to lean on that strength in the running game kwity paye edge las vegas raiders the raiders gave paye 16 million per year in free agency he had eight pressures in the raiders 39 week 1 win over the dolphins interestingly the raiders and defensive coordinator rob leonard rushed paye from the interior in sunday 39 s game when they got to three edge rusher packages maxx crosby and malcolm koonce were on the edges on those looks paye 39 s pocket pushing and motor really played up in these situations a notable wrinkle that could elevate paye 39 s production it was not something he did often in indianapolis trey hendrickson edge baltimore ravens hendrickson was the top player in my free agency rankings in march the ravens signed him to a four year 112 million deal after the crosby trade with the raiders fell through hendrickson had an encouraging showing in his ravens debut as baltimore dismantled the indianapolis colts hendrickson missed time last season with a core injury on sunday he looked healthy powerful and explosive he finished with four pressures and got the better of colts left tackle bernhard raimann roy lopez idl arizona cardinals lopez was not a splash signing this offseason he joined the cardinals on a two year 10 5 million deal lopez was extremely disruptive in the cardinals 39 surprise win over the chargers the chargers 39 interior offensive line struggled to block lopez both in the run and pass games he was one of the cardinals 39 best players in an impressive defensive performance trending down devin lloyd lb carolina panthers the panthers were active on defense in free agency they signed edge rusher jaelan phillips to a deal averaging 30 million per year they signed lloyd to a deal averaging 15 million per year then they went out in week 1 and gave up 59 points to the chicago bears the bears rushed for 291 yards phillips was decent lloyd struggled in all phases he missed tackles he got moved in the run game and was late to diagnose rushing tracks he struggled in coverage including on some zone looks lloyd had flashes as a blitzer but those moments were negated by caleb williams 39 pocket management and escapability lloyd did not look like the same player he was during a breakout season in 2025 it was a rough debut odafe oweh edge washington commanders the commanders signed oweh to a four year 96 million contract in free agency it was a lot of money for a player who filled a third edge role for the chargers after landing in los angeles via trade in october the commanders need oweh to play like a no 1 edge he did not perform at that level in a week 1 loss to the philadelphia eagles oweh had one clean up sack and a tackle for loss in the run game but he was not impactful on a down to down basis he had trouble getting loose from eagles tackles jordan mailata and lane johnson among 96 players with at least 20 pass rush snaps in week 1 oweh ranked 84th in pressure rate according to trumedia romeo doubs wr new england patriots this offseason the patriots cut stefon diggs and signed doubs to a four year 80 million contract doubs had a horrible debut in the league 39 s season opener last week against the seattle seahawks a j brown who the patriots traded for in june suffered an injury in the second half doubs did not step up as needed after brown went down doubs did not have a catch on three targets he had a game swinging drop on what would have been an explosive play in the fourth quarter of a tie game brown is on injured reserve now and will miss at least the next four games the patriots need far more out of doubs they used him more as a vertical down the field player doubs really thrives more on possession routes new england offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels will need to find a way to get doubs more involved and doubs must make the plays that come his way myles garrett edge los angeles rams the rams trading for garrett was the biggest splash of the offseason garrett however looked shockingly human in the rams 39 loss to the san francisco 49ers in australia garrett was subsequently placed on ir with a knee injury that injury explains a lot because garrett was clearly not himself against the 49ers left tackle trent williams and right tackle colton mckivitz were both very solid in one on one reps against garrett 34 this was the worst version of myself that i 39 ve put out there 34 garrett said after the game according to our nate atkins he will miss at least the next four games a disastrous start to garrett 39 s los angeles chapter john franklin myers idl tennessee titans robert saleh took over as titans coach this offseason tennessee spent in free agency to give saleh talent on defense including signing corners alontae taylor and cor 39 dale flott and franklin myers on the interior the jets ran the ball very well and that limited pass rushing opportunities franklin myers was not a big factor in the game against the run or pass he had just one pressure the titans signed franklin myers to a deal averaging 21 million per year franklin myers is a very talented rusher the titans have to stop the run better to get the most out of their expensive front seven signing this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: NFL Power Rankings, Week 2: Seahawks leapfrog Broncos and Rams into No. 1 spot; Chiefs hit top 10

news_mentions.body_text: week 1 is complete and as is always the case with the opening weekend of a new season surprises appeared all over the place the cardinals rolled into sofi stadium punched the chargers in the mouth stole their lunch money and ran back to the desert cackling with satisfaction the saints nearly pulled off a legendary comeback in detroit and for yet another year we learned it was unwise to trust the hype surrounding the cowboys who climbed who fell and which of these movers will age poorly in a month s time let s rank all 32 note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 1 edition of the power rankings

news_mentions.headline: Brian Flores-Ben Johnson showdown takes center stage in Vikings-Bears Week 2 matchup
news_mentions.body_text: two years ago in the lead up to one of these clashes a reporter coaxed a smile out of then detroit lions offensive coordinator ben johnson the reporter had asked about minnesota vikings defensive coordinator brian flores 39 blitz packages how the reporter wondered did the relentless pressure tax players 39 minds johnson steely as ever listened to the full question a grin formed 34 yeah um 133 34 johnson said before chuckling his initial reaction carried a tinge of mischief it felt like the reaction of a poker shark at a hold 39 em table the type of response you 39 d have about an opponent you know is always up to something the reporter followed up on the initial question citing a compliment from flores about johnson 39 s abilities how flattering was that to hear 34 i think he 39 s trying to just butter us up a little bit 34 johnson said he smirked once more another brief window into a vaunted back and forth that returns this weekend johnson is now the head coach of the chicago bears and for the seventh time these two foes will meet in a critical nfc north matchup winning offers far more than just bragging rights the victor will establish solid footing in a divisional race that 39 s likely to be decided down the stretch it simplifies the nuances of any matchup to pit two play callers against each other this though is a special case johnson 39 s offense represents creativity and detail born from a self made coaching career flores 39 defense embodies a trademark fearlessness the vikings don 39 t blitz because it 39 s flashy or because it produces eye popping graphics they send waves of bodies at offenses from all sides because that 39 s what they think is most likely to produce the right result johnson has publicly stated his preference for points and blowouts flores makes no bones about his desire to apply a vise grip to opposing offenses neither settles for satisfaction both recognize the challenge the other presents 34 they do a great job 34 flores said tuesday afternoon 34 there 39 s shifts there 39 s motions there 39 s a lot of eye candy they do everything that could potentially give a defense problems 34 he even offered a window into how his mind might work sunday at soldier field employ one deep safety and chicago 39 s wideouts may feast against man to man coverage shift and feature two deep safeties and the bears could find susceptibilities in minnesota 39 s ability to stop the run and that 39 s only the tip of the iceberg safety positioning matters but so do protection rules and pre snap signals and down and distance tendencies each coverage choice comes with a cost different run concepts open the door to holes all avenues of communication matter because they could contain the key for either side to decipher the deception as former vikings defensive lineman harrison phillips put it several years ago playing johnson is like navigating a volatile stock market you enter with expectations but every drive seems like a forecasting exercise does it make sense to sell off while ahead should minnesota adjust schematically even if the team is succeeding or does it make sense to stick with the investment should minnesota maintain its approach betting against chicago 39 s ability to find a quick answer the shared history only adds to the complexity of the decisions 34 each week you try to find a weakness in the armor and look to attack it 34 johnson said ahead of the highly anticipated vikings lions bout in week 18 of the 2024 season 34 this defense doesn 39 t have much and it 39 s been that way for two years now you can tell that this whole unit has been together they have the answers they know how to respond when they get hit with something 34 going back to johnson and flores 39 first faceoffs in 2023 a visual breakdown of the quarter by quarter efficiency statistics looks like a round by round scoring of hagler hearns throwing the uppercut is less important than being able to absorb one in the week 7 confrontation between johnson 39 s lions and flores 39 vikings in 2024 minnesota limited detroit to a minuscule 21 4 percent success rate in the first quarter detroit answered with a ridiculous 61 1 percent success rate in the second quarter the lions kept their momentum with a 54 5 percent success rate in the third quarter but the vikings eliminated the rhythm by holding them to a 27 8 percent success rate in the fourth detroit won 31 29 but the lopsided blow by blow revealed the ingenuity of their staffs and players both coaches worked with a collective to identify and solve problems on the fly this takes sharp eyes from above intricate sideline dialogue and shrewd on field adaptation 34 any type of offense that 39 s out there ground and pound run and shoot rpo 4 by 1 he 39 s got it 34 flores said 34 so what are we getting this week it 39 s hard to know a lot of the game is adjustments if they do this we want to do this we 39 re going to have our own game plan and it 39 s the same on his end with him asking 39 what are they doing how are we going to counteract it 39 34 last year against flores johnson utilized condensed formations quick snaps and third down runs at a notable clip flores meanwhile kept his max pressure calls to a minimum against johnson he also deployed mostly zone coverage out of heavier personnel to neutralize the bears 39 run pass multiplicity also like poker players they understand the others 39 preferences they know what moves the other prefers to make on the field 34 it 39 s one of the things i love about coaching defense in this division in the nfc 34 flores said 34 it 39 s a lot of fun 34 it 39 s fun to watch as well this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Colts WR Keenan Allen formally charged in alleged drunken driving incident
news_mentions.description: Colts receiver Keenan Allen will face two misdemeanor charges in an alleged drunken driving incident, according to court records.
news_mentions.body_text: indianapolis indianapolis colts receiver keenan allen will face two misdemeanor charges in an alleged drunken driving incident according to court records the six time pro bowler was formally charged tuesday with operating a vehicle with alcohol concentration equivalent to 0 15 or more and operating a vehicle while intoxicated he posted 500 cash bond and his attorneys waived an initial hearing that had been scheduled for wednesday an attorney conference is set for oct 26 colts coach shane steichen declined to address the latest twist before wednesday s practice at which allen is expected to be a participant allen has not addressed the incident publicly according to the indianapolis metropolitan police department officers conducted a traffic investigation on aug 30 shortly after 1 a m after observing a vehicle park in a no parking zone officers noticed signs of intoxication when they spoke with allen he was arrested after further investigation the 34 year old allen is in his 14th nfl season his first with indy after spending 12 of his previous 13 years with the san diego los angeles chargers he signed with the colts on aug 19 reuniting him with steichen who was a chargers assistant for the first seven years of allen s career allen had 81 receptions for 777 yards and four touchdowns in 17 games with the chargers last season when he broke the franchise s career receptions record he finished his chargers career with 985 catches 11 307 yards and 63 tds in sunday s season opening 41 23 loss to the baltimore ravens allen led the colts with six receptions but had only 32 yards allen needs two receptions to pass andre johnson 1 062 for 12th and 64 yards to pass charlie joiner for 30th on the nfl s career lists his 70 td catches are tied for 52nd all time copyright 2026 by the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Kenneth Walker III pummels Broncos in debut with Chiefs
news_mentions.description: Newly added running back Kenneth Walker III rushed for 173 yards, including a 60-yard TD dash, in his first game in Kansas City.
news_mentions.body_text: kenneth walker s first game in kansas city went as advertised the running back signed in the offseason to revamp a sluggish ground game galloped through the denver broncos defense to the tune of 173 rushing yards including a 60 yard td blast and added 18 yards on three catches with another score in monday night s 31 10 chiefs win walker s physicality ability to break tackles and home run capacity were game changers for an offense that previously leaned too heavily on patrick mahomes making magic i told you all literally like first press conference y all were asking what s the difference with our offense and i said k9 like it s just that simple mahomes said after the win via the team s official transcript it s the way he s able to run the ball catch the ball i threw a little hot to him there on that read that was probably going to be a big play but it s just a special ability to run the ball tough between the tackles and then when he does bounce it he has the speed to go all the way and so we ll utilize him walker set career highs with his 173 rushing yards and 191 scrimmage yards after sharing the backfield with zach charbonnet in seattle walker fit seamlessly in k c as the top dog you know you ve got to be making yards and for him to play the way that he did i thought it was spectacular said coach andy reid it was something you hope for and you got to see it where he was the main guy there and he did a great job with it i ll also say that our rb emmett johnson did a nice job too when he had an opportunity to get in there both those guys are contact balances ridiculous and so they got a lot of yards after contact and that s a special thing to have there walker picked up where he left off last season winning the super bowl mvp with the seattle seahawks his 191 scrimmage yards were the most by a reigning super bowl mvp in week 1 surpassing the previous record of 180 set by hall of famer jerry rice in 1989 per nfl research his career high 173 rushing yards in week 1 are the second highest by any veteran in their debut with a new team behind michael turner s 220 yard performance in his 2008 debut with the falcons perhaps most notable walker s 173 rushing yards were also the most by any player in a game started by mahomes the chiefs have employed an afterthought rushing attack for most of mahomes reign they have never had a 1 000 yard rusher since the qb took over as the starter and the last several seasons have been highly inefficient walker s arrival changed that instantly walker s ability to create splash plays completely changes the k c offense he generated 101 rushing yards over expected per nfl pro and forced a whopping 14 missed tackles the rb showed all of his attributes including game breaking speed on a 60 yard touchdown we ran the play a few times walker said of his 60 yard score i knew they were going to crash in so when they crashed in i just bounced it out i was one on one with the corner i outran him and it was off to the races from there the 60 yard scamper was the chiefs longest run since 2019 when damien williams had td runs of 91 and 84 yards over the past two seasons the longest run by any k c player was 35 yards wr xavier worthy the chiefs force fed walker the ball 26 times including 23 carries reinforcing their belief that he s a three down player it means a lot walker said of the workload it means they trust me it s good to feel that way starting undrafted rookie kahlil benson at left tackle the chiefs knew pounding the rock would be the most prudent way to protect the young blocker that it fit perfectly with the revamped plan this offseason was a bonus the offensive line took it as a challenge to go up against this defense and set the tone and they did that mahomes said and so even though the pass game didn t click the way we wanted it to click early especially it set the tone for the entire game of how we were going to move the ball down the field

news_mentions.headline: Broncos-Chiefs on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Kansas City's 31-10 win
news_mentions.description: After failing to win the AFC West last season for the first time in a decade, the Kansas City Chiefs kicked off the new campaign by dominating the Denver Broncos, who dethroned them in 2025.
news_mentions.body_text: kenneth dials up the kc frequency roughly eight months after taking home super bowl lx mvp honors with the seahawks kenneth walker hit the kansas city ground running and didn t look back walker was sensational from start to finish commanding the spotlight in a performance that lends credence to this being very much a new look and new approach chiefs offense walker s first game in a chiefs uniform ended with him rushing for a career high 173 yards including a 60 yard touchdown run to go with a 2 yard touchdown catch on a forward toss from the triumphantly returning patrick mahomes how walker began the game was probably just as telling he carried it on the chiefs first four plays and seven total on an opening td march that ended with mahomes scrambling in for a 15 yard score the chiefs haven t had a 1 000 yard rusher since kareem hunt in 2017 the last season mahomes wasn t a starter while walker won the super bowl s top individual honor he did so because his former seahawks teammate zach charbonnet was injured for the majority of 2025 walker split carries though the chiefs surprisingly ran roughshod over the broncos defense with rookie emmett johnson and mahomes also chipping in here and there this was walker s night and a message on the marquee the chiefs are going to run the ball and walker will be a workhorse davis denver offense stymied as patrick mahomes made his much ballyhooed return after tearing his acl and lcl last season his former texas tech teammate davis webb was making his debut as the broncos play caller and offensive coordinator monday went much better for mahomes webb and broncos qb bo nix in his first game since breaking his ankle in the divisional round never found any consistent success kenneth walker s 191 total yards for the chiefs bested the broncos 176 nix looked sharper earlier passing than mahomes but it made no matter as the game wore on with denver shockingly held to nine first downs and its ground game non existent j k dobbins was the leading ground gainer with a meager 36 yards while nix s 19 yard td toss to evan engram to tie the game in the first quarter was really the last splash of any kind had by webb s offense after the chiefs vaulted ahead 21 7 on a stellar 60 yard gallop by walker in the third quarter mahomes was picked off by brandon jones on the chiefs ensuing drive set up at the kc 5 yard line nix and the offense went backward and settled for a 31 yard field goal by wil lutz denver s last points of the game with such high expectations and such a disastrous debut for webb and the offense one has to wonder how long head coach sean payton will wait until snatching the offensive reins back mahomes returns chiefs win somehow some way patrick mahomes return nine months to the day of ripping multiple ligaments was overshadowed by the debut of a soft spoken loud running kenneth walker nonetheless mahomes had his moments in a return to action that had more good than bad but was hardly vintage pat the first six points of the game were had by mahomes when he scrambled up the gut and dove head first for a 15 yard touchdown carrying his hulking left knee brace along with him if any of the score s symbolism was lost mahomes made sure to underscore it by flexing his right arm to the camera he was back strong as ever the three time super bowl mvp showed some unease in the pocket though often more comfortable perhaps surprisingly on the move and was at times woefully inaccurate he finished 15 of 27 for 184 yards two touchdowns and an interception he hit rashee rice on a screen that the receiver took in for a 13 yard score and his td pass to walker was an underhand toss there is plenty more for mahomes to show to prove the mahomes of old is back with walker in place though andy reid has made it known that the chiefs are changing gears this no longer has to be mahomes carrying the entire offense on his shoulders and surgically repaired knee he can progress week by week and the chiefs can still be viable they were dominant on monday thanks to walker and a stellar defensive performance most importantly mahomes is back and the chiefs returned to the winner s circle in his return stopping a three game skid against the broncos and an overall six game losing streak dating back to last season broncos d is no show for as problematic as the broncos offensive showing was their defensive performance was perhaps more worrisome bo nix and the offense beyond perhaps one of the better offensive lines in the game is truly still a work in progress vance joseph s defense is coming off back to back seasons as the no 3 unit in points allowed yet the chiefs dominated them in humbling fashion by running them over most troubling was that this vaunted group that s eyeing setting all time sack records was absolutely horrendous in its tackling or lack thereof eight broncos missed multiple tackles per next gen stats as a whole denver missed 28 tackles giving up 247 yards on those missed tackles which is the most by any defense since at least 2018 per ngs many were of the mind that if nix wasn t injured in the playoffs denver might well have advanced to the super bowl last season thusly many believed the broncos could be super bowl bound this year well denver got nix back but this certainly looked nothing like the defense of the last two seasons chiefs rookies show promise as uneven as patrick mahomes was passing the ball when he connected with travis kelce for a 59 yarder in the third quarter it was a snapshot of the glory days of the chiefs dynasty that really wasn t that long ago kansas city s win had plenty to do with new faces though most obvious was kenneth walker but undrafted free agent kahlil benson starting at left tackle where he didn t play in college and presented the team s biggest question mark was stellar in 32 pass block snaps he allowed just one qb pressure rookie second rounder r mason thomas had a pair of qb pressures and one of the chiefs four sacks first round pick mansoor delane had an interception before exiting with a shoulder injury which was easily the largest negative for the chiefs on the evening shifty rookie running back emmett johnson put together 68 scrimmage yards and the refurbishing of the chiefs after a 6 11 season is off and running with faces old and new making valuable contributions against an afc heavyweight next gen stats insight for broncos chiefs via nfl pro bo nix was pressured on 45 5 of his dropacks the second highest pressure rate faced in his career nfl research kenneth walker had a career high 191 scrimmage yards in his chiefs debut the most scrimmage yards by a reigning super bowl mvp in week 1 surpassing the previous record of 180 set by hall of famer jerry rice in 1989 walker s career best 173 rushing yards in week 1 are second by a veteran player in their debut with a new team behind michael turner s 220 yard performance in his 2008 debut with the falcons

news_mentions.headline: Vikings QB Kyler Murray suffers concussion in first quarter of win over Packers
news_mentions.description: Minnesota Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray suffered a concussion in Sunday's  39-22 win over the Green Bay Packers and did not return.
news_mentions.body_text: minnesota vikings quarterback kyler murray suffered a concussion in sunday s 39 22 win over the green bay packers and did not return on a third and 7 scramble in the first quarter murray slid but took a big hit from packers defenders lukas van ness and javon bullard murray s helmet came off on the play and the veteran qb remained on the turf at u s bank stadium before eventually walking off under his own power and exiting to the locker room i have no update on how those evaluations have gone head coach kevin o connell said after the game we ll take it day by day and see how he comes in tomorrow o connell added that murray seemed to be doing well after the game but i wouldn t medically quote me on that bullard was flagged for unnecessary roughness on the play to prolong the vikings drive murray was just 11 plays into his debut with the vikings before exiting and went 3 of 5 for 18 yards with an interception carson wentz took over under center for minnesota going 12 of 19 for 133 yards with three touchdowns to lead the vikings to a comeback win

news_mentions.headline: Memorable first games in active NFL stadiums: Giants-Cowboys thriller at Jerry World tops list
news_mentions.description: With the Buffalo Bills opening the new Highmark Stadium on Thursday night, Jeremy Bergman takes a trip down memory lane, ranking the five most memorable first games in active NFL stadiums.
news_mentions.body_text: another opening another shnow thursday night marks a momentous day for the buffalo bills as they play their first regular season game in their new home with the same name as their old home highmark stadium this highmark stadium is a 2 2 billion behemoth flush with massive bison statues out front a view of the buffalo skyline from the upper deck in orchard park and a new head coach a younger model of course the headlines leading into thursday evening s housewarming with the detroit lions skew skeptical of the new digs some fans attending the stadium s public unveiling noted that their sightlines were obstructed earlier this month the grounds crew had to replace the field s actual field after players noted clumps of the turf were coming up during preseason games but the best way to get rid of negative press is to create positive memories or at least memorable moments the most recent stadium debuts didn t get that opportunity the rams and chargers opened sofi stadium and the raiders debuted allegiant stadium back in 2020 in the midst of the covid 19 outbreak attendance was heavily restricted across the league with essentially zero fans present in inglewood california and las vegas leading players to gesture toward empty seats and cutouts after scoring touchdowns and snagging interceptions that won t be the case in buffalo where bills mafia is sure to provide a hearty welcome to their beloved boys in blue and a hostile reception to the visitors if bills fans are seeking inspiration for how an nfl stadium debut should go i ve got them covered after compiling the top stadium farewells last season for buffalo s au revoir to the ralph i ve ranked the most memorable first games in active nfl stadiums not counting highmark sofi and allegiant there are 27 to choose from a number of openings were absolute duds the browns returning to cleveland with a 43 0 loss to pittsburgh in 1999 the oilers and jaguars combining for 125 passing yards in duval in 95 but we ve also experienced some rousing affairs so here s the breakdown starting with the toughest omissions and one oddity then continuing on to the top five countdown just missed the cut lambeau field new city stadium green bay packers packers 21 bears 17 week 1 1957 northwest stadium jack kent cooke stadium washington commanders washington 19 arizona 13 ot week 3 1997 m t bank stadium ravens stadium at camden yards baltimore ravens steelers 20 ravens 13 week 1 1998 raymond james stadium tampa bay buccaneers buccaneers 27 bears 15 week 3 1998 lincoln financial field philadelphia eagles buccaneers 17 eagles 0 week 1 2003 levi s stadium san francisco 49ers bears 28 49ers 20 week 2 2014 honorable mention hard rock stadium miami dolphins opened 1987 as joe robbie stadium first game dolphins 42 chiefs 0 week 5 1987 memorable plays liffort hobley and trell hooper s 50 plus yard fumble return touchdowns within three minutes of each other in the third quarter miami had the misfortune of playing its first regular season home game since moving from the historic orange bowl during the 1987 players strike the dolphins were originally scheduled to open their new stadium in miami gardens against the reigning champion giants but their week 3 matchup was cancelled due to the onset of the strike two weeks later with replacement players on the roster miami hosted kansas city for a bizarre home opening in a stadium with a capacity upwards of 70 000 just under 26 000 attended the dolphins as they were were quarterbacked not by dan marino but by kyle mackey an 11th round pick of the st louis cardinals in the 1984 nfl draft little was needed of mackey as ronald scott a running back out of southern carried the day scoring the only three touchdowns of his nfl career on 18 carries he got the start the following week and never played another game in the league miami s defense helped matters with two 50 plus yard scoops and scores in the third quarter throttling a chiefs offense led by alex espinoza who completed nine of 14 attempts for 69 yards in his only career nfl outing the game is only memorable in that it was unique fans of the era will barely even recall it because the contest was partially blacked out in the miami and kansas city areas due to low attendance figures and a non competitive finish poor dick enberg and merlin olsen quotable from behind the glass of his private box joe robbie himself waved imperially down upon his flock if he counted heads and didn t find enough to meet the mortgage it wasn t showing sunday one of the most memorable days in south florida sports history he proclaimed arrogantly disregarding the truths of the day south florida sun sentinel 5 soldier field chicago bears opened 1924 1971 as bears full time home first game bears 17 steelers 15 week 1 1971 memorable play kent nix s game winning td pass to george farmer in the fourth quarter the bears very first game at soldier field was so long ago that anyone in attendance would be at the very least 100 years old at time of publication not so memorable i guess was the bears 10 0 shutout win over the crosstown cardinals in week 9 of the 1926 campaign no offense to coach george halas duke hanny paddy driscoll and milt romney really but the first bears game after moving south from wrigley field to soldier field their new permanent residence was a doozy well for at least one quarter facing chuck noll and terry bradshaw s steelers one year pre immaculate reception the bears went down 15 3 in the fourth unable to stop john fuqua and warren bankston on the ground but later in the quarter bankston fumbled on two consecutive drives the first fell to ross brupbacher who ran the pigskin back 30 yards to the end zone the second was forced by the great dick butkus who also picked off bradshaw on the day and the bears got the ball back in position to score trailing by five points coach jim dooley then replaced starting qb jack concannon with kent nix who picked up a first down with his legs and then tossed his lone completion of the game to george farmer for an 8 yard td connection it was merely a moment in time for nix who ended up starting four games in 71 despite completing 37 2 of his passes on the year but he ll always be remembered as the qb who pioneered the bears first victory at their forever home quotable the most heartsick fans in the sports world today must be those among the record bear home crowd of 55 049 who left yesterday s game in rainy soldier field five minutes early oh ye of so little faith cooper rollow chicago tribune 4 reliant stadium houston texans opened 2002 first game texans 19 cowboys 10 week 1 2002 memorable play david carr s 65 yard td pass to corey bradford in the fourth quarter the nfl s first true expansion team in seven years and still the most recent one the houston texans enjoyed arguably the most emphatic first game in nfl history with no 1 overall pick david carr under center the texans franchise welcomed the nfl back to houston in a prime time showcase against america s team the in state rival dallas cowboys jerry jones was happy to share the spotlight with texans owner bob mcnair for only a few minutes before his boys fell behind built just next to the astrodome which was vacated by the oilers turned titans after the 1996 season reliant stadium was rocking after carr delivered a td strike to billy miller less than 75 seconds into the game and the party never stopped even after carr found corey bradford streaking down the right sideline in a tie ballgame in the fourth quarter hitting him in the hands just ahead of darren woodson and leading bradford into the end zone for what would be a game winning 65 yard td pass houston sealed the deal with a safety of quincy carter to become the first expansion team to win its debut since minnesota achieved the feat in 1961 since that fateful day the texans haven t quite taken over the cowboys position as the face of professional football in texas but they ve made their mark winning eight afc south titles over the past 15 years it all started with the energy brought at reliant stadium on that opening night quotable for almost the entire game it was difficult to tell who was the expansion team and who was america s team john mcclain houston chronicle 3 ford field detroit lions opened 2002 first game packers 37 lions 31 week 3 2002 memorable play az zahir hakim s 72 yard punt return touchdown to open up the scoring the lions brought nfl football back to downtown detroit in 2002 after nearly three decades at the silverdome in pontiac and their re introduction was a classic hosting brett favre and the hated packers the lions led by first round pick joey heisman harrington in his first start went toe to toe with the eventual nfc north champions this rivalry bout was littered with big plays it opened with an az zahir hakim 72 yard reverse punt return td for detroit followed by a marques anderson 78 yard pick six for green bay favre then threw a td pass to future pro bowler donald driver harrington responded with a 39 yard scoring strike to lamont warren before halftime after a big start to the second half pushed the packers to a 34 17 lead detroit responded with two touchdowns including a 52 yard james stewart scamper after the two minute warning following a green bay field goal harrington got the ball back with just over a minute left embracing his hero s moment harrington drove detroit inside green bay s 35 yard line but after the no 3 overall pick just missed mikhael ricks over the top harrington threw a game sealing interception his fourth of the day in the middle of the field cementing detroit s first loss to the packers at ford field quotable and the honeymoon s over green bay 37 detroit 31 the season is still winless the defense is still porous and we re out of new stadiums mitch albom detroit free press 2 nissan stadium tennessee titans opened 1999 as adelphia coliseum first game titans 36 bengals 35 week 1 1999 memorable play al del greco s game winning 33 yard field goal after years in the wilderness of tennessee the titans ne oilers found their identity in 1999 in the confines of adelphia coliseum built on the east bank of the cumberland river in nashville jeff fisher s tennessee oilers spent the 1997 and 98 seasons playing in memphis and at vanderbilt respectively but kicked off what would be an historic 1999 campaign in brand new digs the titans season got off to a hot 26 7 start against the overmatched visitors from cincinnati with steve mcnair and kevin dyson toying with the bengals d for a combined three touchdowns in the first half but the bengals led by a cramping jeff blake stormed back to score 28 straight points inspired newly minted titans fans to boo and carried a 35 26 lead deep into the fourth quarter mcnair then brought the titans back down the field and found eddie george for a 17 yard catch and run score after a tennessee defensive stop mcnair days away from back surgery and george moved the ball from the bengals 49 to the 15 where with 12 seconds to go al del greco sent cheering titans fans home victorious with a game sealing 33 yard field goal tennessee surrendered 35 plus points again only twice over its remaining 19 games losing just four times including a heartbreakingly close defeat to the rams in super bowl xxxiv as for the bengals bruce coslet s boys won just one of their next 10 games yet for one sunday afternoon in september the eventual afc champions and afc central afterthoughts were one point apart this season the newly rebranded titans are set to play their final regular season game in adelphia coliseum now named nissan stadium against another former afc central rival in the steelers could another streaky shootout be in the offing quotable the booing gave me even more motivation to go out and get the job done i don t understand it but the team surrounded me and said don t worry and we came out on top that s what counts steve mcnair via the associated press 1 at t stadium dallas cowboys opened 2009 as cowboys stadium first game giants 33 cowboys 31 week 1 2009 memorable play eli manning s tipped third down conversion to mario manningham followed by lawrence tynes game winning field goal it doesn t get bigger than the opening of jerry world the debut of cowboys stadium in 2009 was a monumental culture event attended by former president george w bush and over 105 000 spectators the game delivered on the occasion the cowboys and archrival giants less than two years removed from their fateful divisional round clash at texas stadium went back and forth all sunday night trading points and crazy plays there was bruce johnson s 34 yard pick six of tony romo in the first quarter kenny phillips interception off a deflection off jason witten s heel in the second mario manningham s juggling 22 yard td grab in the final minute of the half felix jones 56 yard run in the third and eli manning s game winning drive in the fourth that march which came after dallas went up 31 30 with 3 40 to go ate up the rest of the clock with manning connecting with kevin boss steve smith and manningham for four first downs with four seconds left on the clock and after a wade phillips icing of the kicker lawrence tynes booted home a 37 yard field goal to seal the win for big blue and spoil the cowboys grand opening jones may not have enjoyed the result but surely appreciated eight lead changes worth of entertainment quotable we appreciate 100 000 people cheering us on we enjoyed watching ourselves on the tv giants linebacker antonio pierce via the new york times
